programme.title: Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH | Football - Wwin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine. | Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984.

programme.title: Fudbal - Italijanska liga | FBBAL - Italian League
programme.desc: Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada. | Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs.

programme.title: Fudbal - Kup Njemačke | Football - German Cup

programme.title: Fudbal - Italijanski kup | Football - Italian Cup
programme.desc: Talijanski kup stvara svoju istoriju od 1922. i prvog izdanja. Za naredni trofej ekipe sa Apeninskog poluostrva morale su čekati do 1936. kada je takmičenje ponovo počelo i održavalo se svake godine. Pomalo znatiželjna činjenica je manja posjećenost stadiona u odnosu na "Seriju A" zbog tradicije odmaranja najboljih igrača najjačih talijanskih ekipa. Međutim, sve se svodi na vodu kad se turnir završi kada pobjedniku bude zajamčeno sigurno mjesto u grupi UEFA Europa lige. Tada se zanimanje za ovo takmičenje naglo povećava. Pravi navijač italijanskog fudbala sigurno će pratiti ovo takmičenje! | The Italian Cup creates its history since 1922. and the first edition. For the next trophy of the team from the Apennine Peninsula, they had to wait until 1936. When the competition began again and maintained each year. A somewhat curious fact is a smaller attendance of the stadium in relation to the "series of A" due to the tradition of resting the best players of the strongest Italian teams. However, everything comes down to water when the tournament is completed when the winner is guaranteed a safe place in the UEFA Europa League group. Then the interest in this competition increases abruptly. The real fan of Italian football will surely follow this competition!

The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet.

programme.title: Košarka - ABA liga | Basketball - ABA League
programme.desc: ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone. | The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season.

programme.title: Košarka - ABA liga | Basketball - ABA League
programme.desc: ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone. | The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season.

programme.title: Fudbal - Rumunjska liga | Football - Romania League
programme.desc: Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak. | Romania's first football league has a long history, the first season has been played back in 1909. year when the first title won the extinguished Olympi Bucharest today. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steau and Dinamo from Bucharest who took most of the title of champions. The League currently has 14 clubs and after "regular" work, where everyone plays one game at home and one in the guests, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is play off for the champion where six best clubs are participated as the rest is struggling in a special part for survival.

programme.title: Fudbal: HNL | Football: HNL
programme.desc: Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo. | Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly.

programme.title: Fudbal - Superliga Srbije | Football - Superliga Serbia
programme.desc: Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji. | The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful.

programme.title: Fudbal: Francuska 2. liga | Football: France 2. League
programme.desc: Ligue 2 drugi je po niou razred francuskih klupskih fudbalskih takmičenja. Liga je osnovana 1933. godine i u današnjem formatu broji ukupno 20 klubova. Ligaški deo sastoji je od 38 kola u kojima svaka ekipa kod kuće i u gostima igra sa svakim od preostalih klubova u ligi. Dve najbolje plasirane ekipe ostvaruju direktna plasman u Ligue 1 dok još tri kluba kroz dodatno razigravanje lovi još jednu poziciju za plasman u elitni razred francuskog fudbala. Dve poslednje ekipe ispadaju u niži rang takmičenja. | Ligue 2 The second is on the Niou class of French club football competitions. League was founded in 1933. year and in today's format has a total of 20 clubs. The league part consists of 38 cars in which each team at home and plays with every one of the remaining clubs in the league. The two best placed teams achieve a direct placement in Ligue 1 while another three clubs through additional playing hunts another position for the placement in the elite grade of French football. The two last teams fall out in the lower rank of competition.

Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo. | Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly.

programme.title: Fudbal - Superliga Srbije | Football - Superliga Serbia
programme.desc: Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji. | The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful.

programme.title: Fudbal: Francuska 2. liga | Football: France 2. League
programme.desc: Ligue 2 drugi je po niou razred francuskih klupskih fudbalskih takmičenja. Liga je osnovana 1933. godine i u današnjem formatu broji ukupno 20 klubova. Ligaški deo sastoji je od 38 kola u kojima svaka ekipa kod kuće i u gostima igra sa svakim od preostalih klubova u ligi. Dve najbolje plasirane ekipe ostvaruju direktna plasman u Ligue 1 dok još tri kluba kroz dodatno razigravanje lovi još jednu poziciju za plasman u elitni razred francuskog fudbala. Dve poslednje ekipe ispadaju u niži rang takmičenja. | Ligue 2 The second is on the Niou class of French club football competitions. League was founded in 1933. year and in today's format has a total of 20 clubs. The league part consists of 38 cars in which each team at home and plays with every one of the remaining clubs in the league. The two best placed teams achieve a direct placement in Ligue 1 while another three clubs through additional playing hunts another position for the placement in the elite grade of French football. The two last teams fall out in the lower rank of competition.

The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful.

programme.title: Футбол: УЕФА Европейско първенство за жени 2025: Полуфинал: Германия - Испания | Football: UEFA European Women's Championship 2025: Semi -finals: Germany - Spain
programme.desc: 16-те най-добри дамски отбора на континента се събират в Швейцария, за да се борят за купата в 14-ия европейски шампионат. Отборът на Англия ще защитава титлата си, спечелена преди 3 години на родна земя. Най-големите конкурентки са световните шампионки от Испания, които са и отборът с най- предно класиране от Европа в ранглистата на ФИФА – второ място. Съставът на Германия, който загуби финала преди 3 години след продължения, е рекордьор по европейски победи, като е триумфирал 8 пъти в досегашните 13 издания, но последната им титла е от 2013 г. В първата десетка на световната ранглиста са още отборите на Швеция и Франция. | The 16 best ladies' teams on the continent gather in Switzerland to fight for the Cup in the 14th European Championship. The team of England will defend its title, won 3 years ago on home land. The biggest competitors are the world champions from Spain, who are the team with the most front ranking in Europe in the FIFA rankings- second place. The German squad, which lost the final 3 years ago, is a record holder for European victories, triumphed 8 times in the previous 13 editions, but their last title has been in 2013 in the top ten of the world rankings are the teams of Sweden and France.

programme.title: Арена спорт | Arena Sports
programme.desc: Аналитично-информационното спортно предаване "Арена Спорт" ще отведе зрителите отвъд чистите новини в спорта, като ги разшири и обогати не само с картина, но и с първите коментари и реакции на случващото се. | The analytical information sports show "Arena Sport" will take viewers beyond the pure news in the sport, expanding them not only with a picture, but also with the first comments and reactions to what is happening.

programme.title: Зала на славата: Мария Гигова | Hall of Fame: Maria Gigova
programme.desc: "Зала на славата" е рубрика, в която представяме най-известните лица от голямата златна плеяда български спортисти. Тези значими имена, които със своите успехи през годините са радвали любителите на спорта в нашата страна. В "Зала на славата" те разказват за себе си - за успехите, разочарованията, трудностите, върховете, за миналото и настоящето, за спорта, който играе огромна роля в живота и за живота след спорта. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт. | "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, which, with their success over the years, have enjoyed sports lovers in our country. In the Hall of Glory, they tell about themselves - about successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about sports, which plays a huge role in life and for life after sports. Thanks to the rich archive of Bulgarian National Television, you will have the opportunity to see the biggest successes of the stars of Bulgarian sport.

programme.desc: Разказва за живота на някои посетители и жители на Рим: връзките, приключенията и трудностите, в които попадат. | It tells of the lives of some visitors and residents of Rome: the relationships, adventures and difficulties they fall into.

programme.title: Пчеларят | Beekeeper
programme.desc: След сватбата на дъщеря си, домът на Спирос е изпълнен с тишина. Докато семейството му отпътува, той, вечният пътешественик с пчелите си, тръгва по пътищата. Съдбата го среща с млада автостопаджийка, чиято свобода го завладява. Между тях се създава неочаквана връзка, която ще го постави пред изпитание. | After her daughter's wedding, Spiros' home is filled with silence. As his family departs, he, the eternal traveler with his bees, goes on the roads. Fate meets him with a young carpiece whose freedom conquers him. An unexpected connection is created between them, which will put him to the test.

programme.desc: "Последният печели" е забавно-познавателно, семейно куиз шоу, в което участват четирима играчи. Състои се от три кръга с различни сфери на познанието, в които въпросите са с различна точкова стойност. След края на всеки кръг отпада по един участник, а победителят печели правото да се състезава и в следващия епизод и играе, докато някой друг не успее да го победи. | "The Last Win" is a fun-cognitive, family quiz show involving four players. It consists of three rounds with different spheres of knowledge, in which the questions are of different point value. After the end of each round, one participant drops out, and the winner wins the right to compete in the next episode and plays until someone else is able to beat him.

programme.title: Engers - Frankfurt, Nogomet, Njemački kup | Engers - Frankfurt, Football, German Cup
programme.desc: DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka, 2025) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi... | DFB-Pokal-(Sport. Program, Germany, 2025) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Cup dates back to 1935 when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pocal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, with the first four teams on the third league rankings. The rest of the participants come by the winner of the regional buyers. The matches are played for a single Cup system in which extensions are played after a regular 90 minutes and after the penalty box if the winner does not decide by then. The finals have been played every year starting in 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The Cup winner provides a placement in the UEFA Europa League ...

The matches are played for a single Cup system in which extensions are played after a regular 90 minutes and after the penalty box if the winner does not decide by then. programme.title: Dynamo Dresden - Mainz, Nogomet, Njemački kup | Dynamo Dresden - Mainz, Football, German Cup
programme.desc: DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka, 2025) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi... | DFB-Pokal-(Sport. Program, Germany, 2025) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Cup dates back to 1935 when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pocal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, with the first four teams on the third league rankings. The rest of the participants come by the winner of the regional buyers. The matches are played for a single Cup system in which extensions are played after a regular 90 minutes and after the penalty box if the winner does not decide by then. The finals have been played every year starting in 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The Cup winner provides a placement in the UEFA Europa League ...

Pomalo kuriozitetan podatak je slabija posjećenost stadiona u odnosu na Serie A zbog tradicije odmaranja ponajboljih igrača najjačih talijanskih momčadi. No, sve to pada u vodu prilikom završnice turnira kada se pobjedniku osigurava sigurno mjesto u skupinama UEFA Europa lige. Tada interes za ovo natjecanje rapidno raste. For the next trophy of the team from the Apennine Peninsula, they should have waited until 1936 when the competition began to be held again and held every year. A bit of a curiosity data is a weaker attendance of the stadium over Serie A because of the tradition of resting the best players of the strongest Italian teams. However, all this falls into the water during the end of the tournament when the winner is secured a safe place in the UEFA Europa League groups. Then interest in this competition is growing rapidly. A real fan of Italian football will surely accompany this competition! ...

programme.title: Dynamo Dresden - Mainz, Nogomet, Njemački kup | Dynamo Dresden - Mainz, Football, German Cup
programme.desc: DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka, 2025) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi... | DFB-Pokal-(Sport. Program, Germany, 2025) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Cup dates back to 1935 when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pocal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, with the first four teams on the third league rankings. The rest of the participants come by the winner of the regional buyers. The matches are played for a single Cup system in which extensions are played after a regular 90 minutes and after the penalty box if the winner does not decide by then. The finals have been played every year starting in 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The Cup winner provides a placement in the UEFA Europa League ...

The rest of the participants come by the winner of the regional buyers. The matches are played for a single Cup system in which extensions are played after a regular 90 minutes and after the penalty box if the winner does not decide by then. The finals have been played every year starting in 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The Cup winner provides a placement in the UEFA Europa League ...

Program, 2025) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the 1971 European Football Federation. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. When it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and every year is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year ...

Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Europa Ligu. Tijekom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana... | Football: UEFA Europa League - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the 1971 European Football Federation. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. When it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and every year is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year ...

programme.title: Regensburg - Koln, Nogomet, Njemački kup | Regensburg - Koln, Football, German Cup
programme.desc: DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka, 2025) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi... | DFB-Pokal-(Sport. Program, Germany, 2025) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Cup dates back to 1935 when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pocal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, with the first four teams on the third league rankings. The rest of the participants come by the winner of the regional buyers. The matches are played for a single Cup system in which extensions are played after a regular 90 minutes and after the penalty box if the winner does not decide by then. The finals have been played every year starting in 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The Cup winner provides a placement in the UEFA Europa League ...

programme.title: Regensburg - Koln, Nogomet, Njemački kup | Regensburg - Koln, Football, German Cup
programme.desc: DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka, 2025) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi... | DFB-Pokal-(Sport. Program, Germany, 2025) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Cup dates back to 1935 when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pocal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, with the first four teams on the third league rankings. The rest of the participants come by the winner of the regional buyers. The matches are played for a single Cup system in which extensions are played after a regular 90 minutes and after the penalty box if the winner does not decide by then. The finals have been played every year starting in 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The Cup winner provides a placement in the UEFA Europa League ...

programme.desc: Football - SuperSport HNL - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025) Pratite SuperSport hrvatsku nogometnu ligu, nogometno natjecanje najvišeg ranga u Hrvatskoj koje se održava od 1992. godine pod vodstvom Hrvatskoga nogometnog saveza. By 2022, the league was named the first Croatian football league. The top ten football clubs from Croatia participate in the Supersport HNL. The club that is crowned with the title of national champion has the opportunity to try in the 2nd round of the UEFA Champions League, while runner -up and third -placed entering the 2nd round of qualifying for the UEFA European Conference League ...

programme.desc: Football - First Croatian League - (sport. program, 2025) Prva nogometna liga je hrvatsko nogometno natjecanje drugog ranga koje je osnovano je 1991. godine nakon raspada Jugoslavije. Sljedeće godine je odigrana i prva sezona u kojoj su klubovi bili podijeljeni u četiri regije te je iz svake regije jedan klub napredovao viši rang. Uz brojne izmjene sustava natjecanja, ova liga je poznata po razvoju mnogo mladih igrača koji su se kasnije afirmirali u jakim prvoligašima kao što su Dinamo, Hajduk i Rijeka... | Football - First Croatian League - (Sport. Program, 2025) The first football league is the Croatian Football Competition of the second rank, which was founded in 1991 after the breakup of Yugoslavia. Next year, the first season was played in which the clubs were divided into four regions, and a higher ranking was progressed from each region. With numerous changes to the competition system, this league is known for developing many young players who later affirmed themselves in strong first -team players such as Dinamo, Hajduk and Rijeka ...

programme.title: Nogomet: SuperSport Prva nogometna liga | Football: SuperSport First Football League
programme.desc: Football - First Croatian League - (sport. program) Prva nogometna liga je hrvatsko nogometno natjecanje drugog ranga koje je osnovano je 1991. godine nakon raspada Jugoslavije. Sljedeće godine je odigrana i prva sezona u kojoj su klubovi bili podijeljeni u četiri regije te je iz svake regije jedan klub napredovao viši rang. Uz brojne izmjene sustava natjecanja, ova liga je poznata po razvoju mnogo mladih igrača koji su se kasnije afirmirali u jakim prvoligašima kao što su Dinamo, Hajduk i Rijeka... | Football - First Croatian League - (Sport. Program) The First Football League is the Croatian Football Competition of the second rank, which was founded in 1991 after the breakup of Yugoslavia. Next year, the first season was played in which the clubs were divided into four regions, and a higher ranking was progressed from each region. With numerous changes to the competition system, this league is known for developing many young players who later affirmed themselves in strong first -team players such as Dinamo, Hajduk and Rijeka ...

Iako donosimo vijesti i novosti iz svih sportova, naglasak je ipak na našim najjačim klubovima i savezima... | SPORT Sunday - (Sport. Although we bring news and news from all sports, the emphasis is still on our strongest clubs and federations ...

programme.title: Rijeka - Dinamo, SuperSport HNL 2025./2026., 3. kolo | Rijeka - Dinamo, SuperSport HNL 2025/2026, 3rd round
programme.desc: Football - SuperSport HNL - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025) Pratite SuperSport hrvatsku nogometnu ligu, nogometno natjecanje najvišeg ranga u Hrvatskoj koje se održava od 1992. godine pod vodstvom Hrvatskoga nogometnog saveza. Liga je do 2022. godine nosila naziv Prva hrvatska nogometna liga. U SuperSport HNL-u sudjeluje deset najboljih nogometnih klubova iz Hrvatske. Klub koji se okruni titulom državnoga prvaka ima priliku okušati se u 2. pretkolu UEFA Lige prvaka, dok drugoplasirani i trećeplasirani ulaze u 2. pretkolo kvalifikacija za UEFA Europsku konferencijsku ligu... | Football - SuperSport HNL - (Sports. Program, Croatia, 2025) Follow the SuperSport Croatian Football League, the football competition of the highest rank in Croatia, which has been held since 1992 under the leadership of the Croatian Football Federation. By 2022, the league was named the first Croatian football league. The top ten football clubs from Croatia participate in the Supersport HNL. The club that is crowned with the title of national champion has the opportunity to try in the 2nd round of the UEFA Champions League, while runner -up and third -placed entering the 2nd round of qualifying for the UEFA European Conference League ...

programme.title: Hrvatska - Norveška, Košarka, pretkvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo | Croatia - Norway, basketball, prequalifications for the World Cup
programme.desc: Basketball: FIBA World Cup European Qualifiers - (sport. program, 2025) Za nastup na Svjetskom prvenstvu borit će se 32 europske reprezentacije. Bit će podijeljeni u osam skupina po četiri ekipe. Po tri najbolje reprezentacije iz svake skupine plasirat će se u drugi krug kvalifikacija, gdje će se dvadeset i četiri reprezentacije boriti za dvanaest mjesta što će dovesti do okršaja najboljih svjetskih reprezentacija... | Basketball: FIBA World Cup European Qualifiers - (Sport. Program, 2025) 32 European national teams will fight at the World Cup. It will be divided into eight groups of four teams. The three best national teams from each group will be placed in the second round of qualifications, where twenty-four national teams will fight for twelve places that will lead to the skirmish of the world's best national teams ...

programme.title: BSK - Opatija, SuperSport Prva nogometna liga 2025./2026., 1. kolo | BSK - Opatija, SuperSport First Football League 2025/2026, 1st round
programme.desc: Football - First Croatian League - (sport. program, 2025) Prva nogometna liga je hrvatsko nogometno natjecanje drugog ranga koje je osnovano je 1991. godine nakon raspada Jugoslavije. Sljedeće godine je odigrana i prva sezona u kojoj su klubovi bili podijeljeni u četiri regije te je iz svake regije jedan klub napredovao viši rang. Uz brojne izmjene sustava natjecanja, ova liga je poznata po razvoju mnogo mladih igrača koji su se kasnije afirmirali u jakim prvoligašima kao što su Dinamo, Hajduk i Rijeka... | Football - First Croatian League - (Sport. Program, 2025) The first football league is the Croatian Football Competition of the second rank, which was founded in 1991 after the breakup of Yugoslavia. Next year, the first season was played in which the clubs were divided into four regions, and a higher ranking was progressed from each region. With numerous changes to the competition system, this league is known for developing many young players who later affirmed themselves in strong first -team players such as Dinamo, Hajduk and Rijeka ...

programme.title: Digitale Ohnmacht - Deutschland im Bann von Big Tech | Digital fainting - Germany in the spell of Big Tech
programme.desc: Deutschland und Europa haben die Kontrolle im Digitalen verloren. US-Plattformen wie X, Facebook und Instagram bestimmen, was wir sehen, woruber wir diskutieren. Unsere Urlaubsfotos, private Nachrichten und berufliche Dokumente liegen zu groSSen Teilen auf den Servern von US-Unternehmen. Aber sie alle sind weder demokratisch legitimiert noch an europaisches Recht gebunden. Und jetzt verschmelzen die Tech-Milliardare auch noch mit der Trump-Regierung zu einer Machtelite. Wie konnte es so weit kommen und was kann uns jetzt noch retten?Die Journalist*innen Nadia Kailouli und Daniel Brockerhoff rekonstruieren fur diese Dokumentation gemeinsam mit einem Reporter-Team die Fehlentscheidungen der vergangenen 30 Jahre, treffen Politiker, Experten und Aussteiger aus der Tech-Szene und fragen, wie Deutschland und Europa ihre digitale Souveranitat zuruckerobern konnen.Mathias Dopfner ist Chef von einem der groSSten Medienkonzerne Europas, dem Axel-Springer-Verlag. Schon fruh sah er in den US-Tech-Konzernen ein Vorbild, knupfte Kontakte ins Silicon Valley. Heute beurteilt er die Dominanz von Google, Meta und Co. allerdings kritisch - auch wenn er deren Innovationskraft schatzt. "Bei einem Marktanteil von 95 Prozent gibt es de facto keine Alternative", sagt Dopfner im Interview. Die Hoffnung auf ein deutsches oder europaisches Gegenmodell halt er fur naiv: "Das ware ehrlich gesagt als Plan nicht mutig und risikofreudig, sondern ein bisschen realitatsentruckt und gaga."Diese Marktdominanz will die EU nun begrenzen. Der Digital Markets Act (DMA) soll die Plattformen zu Fairness und Wettbewerb zwingen - und im Zweifel bestrafen. Dafur kampft die deutsche EU-Abgeordnete Alexandra Geese (Bundnis 90/Die Grunen). Die Dokumentation begleitet Geese in die USA, ins Zentrum der Macht nach Washington D.C. Ihre Mission ist es, Werbung zu machen fur die europaischen Ideen: "Gerade auf der demokratischen Seite und bei denjenigen, die einen kritischen Blick auf einige Praktiken dieser Tech-Unternehmen haben, ist die Hoffnung sehr groSS, dass die Losung aus Europa kommt." Viele Republikanerinnen und Republikaner sehen in ihr und der EU mehr Feind als Partner. Aber Geese wird getrieben von Idealismus und der Überzeugung: Europa muss den US-Tech-Konzernen etwas entgegensetzen.Welchen Einfluss die neue politische Richtung in den USA auf ein Tech-Unternehmen haben kann, weiSS er: Daniel Weimert. Er war bei Twitter fur die politischen Kontakte in Deutschland zustandig und erlebte aus nachster Nahe, wie sich die Plattform veranderte, nachdem Elon Musk sie ubernahm. In dieser Dokumentation gibt er erstmals ein ausfuhrliches Interview uber seine Zeit im Unternehmen. Weimert beschreibt den Kurswechsel als radikal: "Es war eine 180-Grad-Wendung." Der Versuch, Meinungsfreiheit und die Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorgaben in Einklang zu bringen, sei zunehmend untergraben worden. Heute sieht er die Plattform zunehmend als ein Gegenmodell zu ihren fruheren Prinzipien.Zwischen Krise, Abhangigkeit und Aufbruch erzahlt die Dokumentation "Digitale Ohnmacht" von einer Demokratie im digitalen Stresstest. | Germany and Europe have lost control in digital. US platforms such as X, Facebook and Instagram determine what we see, what we discuss. Our vacation photos, private news and professional documents are large parts of the US companies servers. But all of them are neither democratically legitimized nor bound to European law. And now the tech billionaries are also fusing a power elite with the Trump government. How could it get that far and what else can save us? The journalists Nadia Kailouli and Daniel Brockerhoff reconstruct for this documentary together with a reporter team The wrong decisions of the past 30 years, politicians, experts and dropouts from the tech scene and questions how Germany and Europe can relapse their digital sovereignty. From one of the greatest media groups in Europe, the Axel Springer publishing house. He already saw Fruh a role model in the US tech corporations, stealing contacts in Silicon Valley. Today, however, he assesses the dominance of Google, Meta and Co. critically - even if he teases its innovative strength. "With a market share of 95 percent, there is de facto no alternative," says Dopfner in an interview. He thinks the hope of a German or European counter -model for naive: "To be honest, that was not brave and keen to risk, but a bit of reality content and Gaga." The EU now wants to limit this market dominance. The Digital Markets Act (DMA) should force the platforms to fairness and competition - and in doubt. The German MEP Alexandra Geese (Bundnis 90/Die Grunen) is fighting for this. The documentation accompanies Geese to the USA, at the center of power according to Washington D.C. Their mission is to advertise the European ideas: "Especially on the democratic side and those who have a critical look at some practices of these tech companies, the hope is very great that the solution will come from Europe." Many Republicans see them more enemy in them and the EU. But Geese is driven by idealism and conviction: Europe has to counter the US tech corporations. On Twitter he was state -of -the -art political contacts in Germany and experienced from Nachster how the platform changed after Elon Musk took it. In this documentation, he gives a detailed interview for the first time in the company. Weimert describes the change of course as radical: "It was an 180-degree application." The attempt to reconcile freedom of expression and compliance with legal requirements has been increasingly undermined. Today he is increasingly seeing the platform as a counter -model to its more early principles. Calculation, dependency and departure, the documentary "digital power of power" is relieved of a democracy in the digital stress test.

programme.title: Echtes Leben | Real life
programme.desc: Sie war einst als "Schwarze Heidi" auf der Comedy-Buhne bekannt - laut, schnell, polarisierend. Heute fuhrt Jeniffer Morland in Berlin drei Restaurants, die noch immer ihren Kunstlernamen tragen. Doch der Weg von der Buhne in die Gastronomie war kein geplanter Karriereschritt, sondern eine Flucht vor dem Schmerz.Als Jeniffers geliebter Stiefvater starb, verstummte ihr Lachen. Die Buhne wurde zu einem Ort, an dem sie nicht mehr sein konnte. Das Leben forderte sie weiter: Personalnot, Finanzprobleme, Sorgen um die Existenz ihrer Restaurants. Doch jetzt will sie zuruck auf die Buhne, zuruck zu sich selbst. Aber die Zeiten haben sich geandert. Ist sie noch lustig?Der Film begleitet Jeniffer Morland aka die "Schwarze Heidi" bei ihrem ungewohnlichen Neuanfang. Wir erleben, wie sie zwischen Kuche, Comedybuhne und Familie ihre Texte schreibt, Auftritte vorbereitet, Ruckschlage einsteckt - und uber sich hinauswachst. Wir reisen mit ihr in die Schweiz zu ihrer Mutter, wo sie aufgewachsen ist und als Schwarzes Madchen mit Rassismus konfrontiert war. Auch ihr verstorbener Stiefvater liegt dort begraben. Wir sehen sie im Spinningraum, wo sie sich und ihre Schuler trainiert, und fiebern mit bei ihrem ersten Open Mic, wo sie endlich wieder auf der Buhne lacht - mit und uber sich selbst.Zwischen wirtschaftlichem Druck und kunstlerischem Aufbruch erzahlt der Film von einer Frau, die keine perfekte Heldin ist - aber eine echte. Und die sich nicht weniger vorgenommen hat, als nachstes Jahr mit den besten Comedians Deutschlands auf einer Buhne zu stehen. Gelingt ihr das groSSe Comeback?Ein Film uber Lachen, Schmerz und Neuanfang. Und den Mut, noch einmal bei null anzufangen - mitten im Leben. | She was once known as a "black Heidi" on the comedy Buhne - loud, fast, polarizing. Today Jeniffer Morland runs three restaurants in Berlin, which are still carrying their art learning names. But the path from the grave to the gastronomy was not a planned step in the career, but an escape from pain. As Jeniffer's beloved stepfather died, her laugh fell silent. The grave became a place where it could no longer be. Life continued to demand: Personnel shortage, financial problems, worried about the existence of her restaurants. But now she wants to go back to herself, back to herself. But times have changed. Is it still funny? The film accompanies Jeniffer Morland aka the "Black Heidi" at her unusual fresh start. We experience how she writes her texts between Kuche, Comedybuhne and Family, prepared appearances, places backstream - and waxed beyond. We travel to Switzerland with her to her mother, where she grew up and was faced with racism as a black girl. Her late stepfather is also buried there. We see her in the spinning room, where she trains herself and her school, and feverish with her first open mic, where she finally laughs on her gray again - with and about herself. The film is the film between a woman who is not a perfect heroine - but a real one. And which has not been less than the following year with the best comedians in Germany to be on a gray. If you succeed in the big comeback? A film about laughter, pain and fresh start. And the courage to start again at zero - in the middle of life.

programme.title: Digitale Ohnmacht - Deutschland im Bann von Big Tech | Digital fainting - Germany in the spell of Big Tech
programme.desc: Deutschland und Europa haben die Kontrolle im Digitalen verloren. US-Plattformen wie X, Facebook und Instagram bestimmen, was wir sehen, woruber wir diskutieren. Unsere Urlaubsfotos, private Nachrichten und berufliche Dokumente liegen zu groSSen Teilen auf den Servern von US-Unternehmen. Aber sie alle sind weder demokratisch legitimiert noch an europaisches Recht gebunden. Und jetzt verschmelzen die Tech-Milliardare auch noch mit der Trump-Regierung zu einer Machtelite. Wie konnte es so weit kommen und was kann uns jetzt noch retten?Die Journalist*innen Nadia Kailouli und Daniel Brockerhoff rekonstruieren fur diese Dokumentation gemeinsam mit einem Reporter-Team die Fehlentscheidungen der vergangenen 30 Jahre, treffen Politiker, Experten und Aussteiger aus der Tech-Szene und fragen, wie Deutschland und Europa ihre digitale Souveranitat zuruckerobern konnen.Mathias Dopfner ist Chef von einem der groSSten Medienkonzerne Europas, dem Axel-Springer-Verlag. Schon fruh sah er in den US-Tech-Konzernen ein Vorbild, knupfte Kontakte ins Silicon Valley. Heute beurteilt er die Dominanz von Google, Meta und Co. allerdings kritisch - auch wenn er deren Innovationskraft schatzt. "Bei einem Marktanteil von 95 Prozent gibt es de facto keine Alternative", sagt Dopfner im Interview. Die Hoffnung auf ein deutsches oder europaisches Gegenmodell halt er fur naiv: "Das ware ehrlich gesagt als Plan nicht mutig und risikofreudig, sondern ein bisschen realitatsentruckt und gaga."Diese Marktdominanz will die EU nun begrenzen. Der Digital Markets Act (DMA) soll die Plattformen zu Fairness und Wettbewerb zwingen - und im Zweifel bestrafen. Dafur kampft die deutsche EU-Abgeordnete Alexandra Geese (Bundnis 90/Die Grunen). Die Dokumentation begleitet Geese in die USA, ins Zentrum der Macht nach Washington D.C. Ihre Mission ist es, Werbung zu machen fur die europaischen Ideen: "Gerade auf der demokratischen Seite und bei denjenigen, die einen kritischen Blick auf einige Praktiken dieser Tech-Unternehmen haben, ist die Hoffnung sehr groSS, dass die Losung aus Europa kommt." Viele Republikanerinnen und Republikaner sehen in ihr und der EU mehr Feind als Partner. Aber Geese wird getrieben von Idealismus und der Überzeugung: Europa muss den US-Tech-Konzernen etwas entgegensetzen.Welchen Einfluss die neue politische Richtung in den USA auf ein Tech-Unternehmen haben kann, weiSS er: Daniel Weimert. Er war bei Twitter fur die politischen Kontakte in Deutschland zustandig und erlebte aus nachster Nahe, wie sich die Plattform veranderte, nachdem Elon Musk sie ubernahm. In dieser Dokumentation gibt er erstmals ein ausfuhrliches Interview uber seine Zeit im Unternehmen. Weimert beschreibt den Kurswechsel als radikal: "Es war eine 180-Grad-Wendung." Der Versuch, Meinungsfreiheit und die Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorgaben in Einklang zu bringen, sei zunehmend untergraben worden. Heute sieht er die Plattform zunehmend als ein Gegenmodell zu ihren fruheren Prinzipien.Zwischen Krise, Abhangigkeit und Aufbruch erzahlt die Dokumentation "Digitale Ohnmacht" von einer Demokratie im digitalen Stresstest. | Germany and Europe have lost control in digital. But all of them are neither democratically legitimized nor bound to European law. And now the tech billionaries are also fusing a power elite with the Trump government. How could it get that far and what else can save us? From one of the greatest media groups in Europe, the Axel Springer publishing house. He already saw Fruh a role model in the US tech corporations, stealing contacts in Silicon Valley. He thinks the hope of a German or European counter -model for naive: "To be honest, that was not brave and keen to risk, but a bit of reality content and Gaga." The EU now wants to limit this market dominance. The Digital Markets Act (DMA) should force the platforms to fairness and competition - and in doubt. Their mission is to advertise the European ideas: "Especially on the democratic side and those who have a critical look at some practices of these tech companies, the hope is very great that the solution will come from Europe." Many Republicans see them more enemy in them and the EU. But Geese is driven by idealism and conviction: Europe has to counter the US tech corporations. In this documentation, he gives a detailed interview for the first time in the company. Weimert describes the change of course as radical: "It was an 180-degree application." The attempt to reconcile freedom of expression and compliance with legal requirements has been increasingly undermined. programme.title: Echtes Leben | Real life
programme.desc: Sie war einst als "Schwarze Heidi" auf der Comedy-Buhne bekannt - laut, schnell, polarisierend. Die Buhne wurde zu einem Ort, an dem sie nicht mehr sein konnte. Das Leben forderte sie weiter: Personalnot, Finanzprobleme, Sorgen um die Existenz ihrer Restaurants. Doch jetzt will sie zuruck auf die Buhne, zuruck zu sich selbst. Aber die Zeiten haben sich geandert. Wir erleben, wie sie zwischen Kuche, Comedybuhne und Familie ihre Texte schreibt, Auftritte vorbereitet, Ruckschlage einsteckt - und uber sich hinauswachst. Wir reisen mit ihr in die Schweiz zu ihrer Mutter, wo sie aufgewachsen ist und als Schwarzes Madchen mit Rassismus konfrontiert war. Auch ihr verstorbener Stiefvater liegt dort begraben. Wir sehen sie im Spinningraum, wo sie sich und ihre Schuler trainiert, und fiebern mit bei ihrem ersten Open Mic, wo sie endlich wieder auf der Buhne lacht - mit und uber sich selbst.Zwischen wirtschaftlichem Druck und kunstlerischem Aufbruch erzahlt der Film von einer Frau, die keine perfekte Heldin ist - aber eine echte. Und die sich nicht weniger vorgenommen hat, als nachstes Jahr mit den besten Comedians Deutschlands auf einer Buhne zu stehen. Und den Mut, noch einmal bei null anzufangen - mitten im Leben. | She was once known as a "black Heidi" on the comedy Buhne - loud, fast, polarizing. programme.desc: Ernst Krenek war einer der bedeutendsten und vielseitigsten Komponisten des 20. Jahrhunderts. With his opera "Jonny plays on", he gained international fame before increasingly turning to the Zwolfton technology. With the support of the National Socialists, he left his home and emigrated to the United States. His time in exile was characterized by artistic productivity, but also by alienation. programme.desc: Jahrhundertelang gehorte die obere Adria zur Habsburgermonarchie und wurde zum Symbol des einstigen Vielvolkerreiches. Geblieben ist ein umfangreiches architektonisches Erbe, prunkvolle Verwaltungsgebaude und Grandhotels, StraSSen- und Eisenbahnverbindungen, die Triest oder Gorz einst mit Wien und Budapest verbanden und Erinnerungen an eine Zeit, die heute wieder als durchaus positiv beurteilt wird. Regisseur Gernot Stadler begibt sich auf Spurensuche in diesem geopolitisch einzigartigen Raum, der auch heute noch gekennzeichnet ist durch die gegenseitige, jahrhundertelange Befruchtung dreier Kulturen und Sprachen. Das einstige osterreichische Kustenland, ursprunglich von Gorz/Gorizia/Nova Goriza, spater von Triest/Trieste/Trst aus verwaltet, ist auch ein Symbol fur das versunkene Vielvolkerreich. Nirgends, schreibt der italienische Schriftsteller Hans Kitzmuller, hatten Deutsche, Slawen und Romanen jahrhundertelang so friedlich zusammengelebt. Der Film portraitiert Menschen, die diese gemeinsame Geschichte gewissermaSSen in sich tragen, wie zum Bespiel Grafin Carolina Lantieri aus Gorz, in deren Stadtpalast einst Maria Theresia, Napoleon, Goethe, Kant oder die letzten franzosischen Konige zu Gast waren.Erika Auchentaller, die Enkelin des groSSen Wiener Sezessionisten Josef Maria Auchentaller, fuhrt durch den beliebten Badeort Grado, den ihr GroSSvater in zahlreichen Gemalden festgehalten hat und der uberhaupt erst durch ihn zu einem der mondansten Seebader der Monarchie wurde. Die Dokumentation begleitet die osterreichische Autorin Christine Casapicola bei ihren Recherchen uber das Kustenland unter anderem zu den einst osterreichischen Salinen von Piran oder zur Weinlese nach Cormons, der fruheren osterreichischen Grenzstadt. Von Cormons aus wurden jedes Fruhjahr Kirschen fur die Obstmarkte nach Wien geliefert.Hans Kitzmuller, ein groSSer Kenner der Geschichte von Gorz und des gesamten Kustenlandes und zugleich leidenschaftlicher Segler, zeigt uns das malerische Inselstadtchen Mali Losinj. Einst wurde es Lussin Grande genannt und war ein beliebter Aufenthaltsort vieler Mitglieder des osterreichischen Kaiserhauses. Die Bauten aus der Monarchie pragen heute noch das Stadtbild des Kurortes. Der Film "Sehnsucht nach dem Kustenland" nimmt die Zuschauer mit auf eine (Zeit)-Reise entlang der heutigen italienischen, slowenischen und kroatischen Kusten, die einst ein illustres adeliges und burgerliches Publikum aus allen Teilen der Donaumonarchie angelockt haben.Eine Dokumentation von Gernot Stadler | For centuries, the upper Adriatic hire the Habsburg monarchy and became a symbol of the former a lot of people. Germans, Italians and Slavs have lived together peacefully in the Kustenland.*The Esterreiche rule has left their mark: magnificent administrative buildings and Grandhotels, street and railway connections that are connected with Vienna and Budapest - and memories of a time that is now positively judged here again.*In 1918, the disintegration of the Habsburg monarchy also went half. Coming of Austria on the upper Adriatic. What has remained an extensive architectural heritage, magnificent administrative building and grand hotels, road and railway connections that Trieste or Gorz once connected to Vienna and Budapest and memories of a time that is again assessed as quite positive today. Director Gernot Stadler goes in search of traces in this geopolitically unique space, which is still characterized by the mutual, centuries -old fertilization of three cultures and languages. The former Esterreichische Kustenland, originally from Gorz/Gorizia/Nova Goriza, later from Trieste/Triest/Trst, is also a symbol for the sunken kingdom. Nowhere, writes the Italian writer Hans Kitzmuller, had lived together so peacefully for centuries. The film portrays people who carry this common story to a certain extent, such as the player Countess Carolina Lantieri from Gorz, in whose city palace once Maria Theresia, Napoleon, Goethe, Kant or the last French king. which her grandfather captured in numerous paintings and at all by him only became one of the most moon -eared seaside bathers of the monarchy. The documentary accompanies the Esterreich author Christine Casapicola during her research on the Kustenland, among other things, to the once Easter -Reich Salines from Piran or the wine harvesting for Cormons, the Fruheren Osterreichische Borderstadt. From Cormons, cherries were delivered to Vienna every early year. Hans Kitzmuller, a great connoisseur of the story of Gorz and the entire Kustlandes and at the same time passionate sailors, shows us the picturesque island city of Mali Losinj. It was once called Lussin Grande and was a popular place of residence of many members of the Easter Kaiserhaus. The buildings from the monarchy are still the cityscape of the health resort. The film "Longing for the Kustland" takes the spectators on a (time) trip along today's Italian, Slovenian and Croatian custody that once attracted an illustrious noble and burger audience from all parts of the Danube monarchy. programme.title: Österreich-Bild aus dem Landesstudio Niederosterreich | Austrian image from the Landesstudio Niederosterreich
programme.sub-title: Ein Land als Vermachtnis - die Babenberger und ihr Österreich
programme.desc: Die Babenberger regieren von 976 bis 1246 Österreich. In ihrer fast 300- jahrigen Regentschaft wachst Österreich und bluht auf. Der Film aus dem ORF Landesstudio Niederosterreich wird als Wiederholung (Dezember 2024) ausgestrahlt (Gestaltung: Sabine Daxberger, Kamera: Philipp Wied, Helmut Muttenthaler) ist eine Spurensuche an Originalschauplatzen in Niederosterreich, wo ihre Herrschaft beginnt. Von Stiften und Burgen bis hin zu Kunstschatzen, am Beispiel von Herrschern wie Markgraf Leopold III, dem Heiligen, den Herzogen Leopold V., Leopold VI. oder Frauen wie Markgrafin Agnes. Die filmische Reise fuhrt weit zuruck in die Welt des Mittelalters, etwa in die Burg Gars am Kamp, in der der spatere Markgraf Leopold III, der Heilige, groSSteils aufwachst.Die Doku besucht Stift Klosterneuburg, das der Heilige Leopold 1114 grundet, zeigt seine dortige Grabstatte und seine prachtig geschmuckte Schadelreliquie. Aber auch Kostbarkeiten aus Agnes und Leopolds Lebenszeit, wie einen geheimnisvollen Schleier, der Agnes zugeschrieben wird oder einen siebenarmigen Bronzeleuchter. Ein Schatz im Stift ist auch die mittelalterliche Abschrift des "Privilegium Minus", jener Urkunde, mit der Stauferkaiser Friedrich Barbarossa Österreich 1256 zum Herzogtum erhebt. programme.title: Vertreibung - Odsun: Die Geschichte der Sudetendeutschen | Expulsion - Odsun: The history of the Sudeten Germans
programme.desc: Sie lebten jahrhundertelang als Nachbarn zusammen: Tschechen und Sudetendeutsche. Doch die Beziehung war nie einfach. Nationalismus und Ressentiments belasteten das Zusammenleben auf beiden Seiten. Die Annexion des Sudetenlandes 1938, der Einmarsch der Deutschen in Prag 1939 und schlieSSlich der Zweite Weltkrieg zerstorten diese fragile Beziehung - und hinterlieSSen tiefe Wunden auf beiden Seiten, die bis heute spurbar sind. Knapp drei Millionen Sudetendeutsche wurden 1945 aus ihrer Heimat vertrieben.Universum History widmet sich diesem dunklen Kapitel europaischer Geschichte.Mit bislang unveroffentlichtem Archivmaterial und Interviews mit Zeitzeugen zeichnet diese Dokumentation die dramatischen Ereignisse der Nachkriegszeit nach. Die osterreichisch-deutsch-tschechische Koproduktion erortert mit jungen Europaern die Frage: Wie steht es heute um die Beziehung dieser beiden Lander? Sind die Wunden der Vergangenheit verheilt? Oder drohen sie im Zuge neuer Nationalismen wieder aufzubrechen?Ein Film von Matthias Schmidt und Vít Polácek | They lived together as neighbors for centuries: Czechs and Sudeten Germans. But the relationship was never easy. Nationalism and resentment burdened living together on both sides. The annexation of the Sudetenland in 1938, the marching in the Germans in Prague in 1939 and finally the Second World War destroyed this fragile relationship - and left deep wounds on both sides, which are still trace. Almost three million Sudeten Germans were driven out of their homeland in 1945.Iniversum History is devoted to this dark chapter of European history. With so far inconsistent archive material and interviews with contemporary witnesses, this documentation traces the dramatic events of the post -war period. The Esterreich-German-Czech co-production with young Europeans tackles the question: What is the relationship between these two countries today? Have the wounds of the past healed? Or threaten to break open in the course of new nationalisms? A film by Matthias Schmidt and Vít Polácek

programme.title: Ernst Krenek - Ein ganzes Jahrhundert Musik | Ernst Krenek - an entire century of music
programme.desc: Ernst Krenek war einer der bedeutendsten und vielseitigsten Komponisten des 20. Jahrhunderts. Doch er war nicht nur ein herausragender Musiker, sondern ein ebenso groSSer Literat. 1900 in Wien geboren, fand er in der Kulturmetropole Inspiration durch Personlichkeiten wie Arnold Schonberg, Franz Schreker und Oskar Kokoschka. Mit seiner Oper "Jonny spielt auf" erlangte er internationale Bekanntheit, bevor er sich zunehmend der Zwolftontechnik zuwandte. Mit der Machtubernahme der Nationalsozialisten verlieSS er seine Heimat und emigrierte in die USA. Seine Zeit im Exil war von kunstlerischer Produktivitat, aber auch von Entfremdung gepragt. Trotz zahlreicher Erfolge blieb er immer zwischen zwei Welten: Er war weder in Österreich noch in Amerika so wirklich zu Hause. Kreneks musikalisches Werk umfasst uber 230 Kompositionen, darunter Opern, Sinfonien und Kammermusik. | Ernst Krenek was one of the most important and versatile composers of the 20th century. But he was not just an outstanding musician, but an equally great literary. Born in Vienna in 1900, he found inspiration in the cultural metropolis by personalities such as Arnold Schonberg, Franz Schreker and Oskar Kokoschka. With his opera "Jonny plays on", he gained international fame before increasingly turning to the Zwolfton technology. With the support of the National Socialists, he left his home and emigrated to the United States. His time in exile was characterized by artistic productivity, but also by alienation. Despite numerous successes, he always remained between two worlds: he was neither at home in Austria nor in America. Krenek's musical work comprises over 230 compositions, including operas, symphonies and chamber music.

Was den staatlichen Einsatz biometrischer Überwachungssysteme betrifft, hat er groSSe Bedenken in Bezug auf Datenschutz und Wahrung der Personlichkeitsrechte, denn im Land fehlt immer noch ein Gesetz zur Regulierung des digitalen Raums. | Whether virtual assistants - so -called chatbots, autonomous vehicles, smart homes, texts created by chatgpt, superior to hundreds of languages, or exchanging real media content known as "deeppakes". programme.title: Vertreibung - Odsun: Die Geschichte der Sudetendeutschen | Expulsion - Odsun: The history of the Sudeten Germans
programme.desc: Sie lebten jahrhundertelang als Nachbarn zusammen: Tschechen und Sudetendeutsche. Doch die Beziehung war nie einfach. Nationalismus und Ressentiments belasteten das Zusammenleben auf beiden Seiten. Die Annexion des Sudetenlandes 1938, der Einmarsch der Deutschen in Prag 1939 und schlieSSlich der Zweite Weltkrieg zerstorten diese fragile Beziehung - und hinterlieSSen tiefe Wunden auf beiden Seiten, die bis heute spurbar sind. Knapp drei Millionen Sudetendeutsche wurden 1945 aus ihrer Heimat vertrieben.Universum History widmet sich diesem dunklen Kapitel europaischer Geschichte.Mit bislang unveroffentlichtem Archivmaterial und Interviews mit Zeitzeugen zeichnet diese Dokumentation die dramatischen Ereignisse der Nachkriegszeit nach. Die osterreichisch-deutsch-tschechische Koproduktion erortert mit jungen Europaern die Frage: Wie steht es heute um die Beziehung dieser beiden Lander? Sind die Wunden der Vergangenheit verheilt? Oder drohen sie im Zuge neuer Nationalismen wieder aufzubrechen?Ein Film von Matthias Schmidt und Vít Polácek | They lived together as neighbors for centuries: Czechs and Sudeten Germans. But the relationship was never easy. Nationalism and resentment burdened living together on both sides. The annexation of the Sudetenland in 1938, the marching in the Germans in Prague in 1939 and finally the Second World War destroyed this fragile relationship - and left deep wounds on both sides, which are still trace. Almost three million Sudeten Germans were driven out of their homeland in 1945.Iniversum History is devoted to this dark chapter of European history. With so far inconsistent archive material and interviews with contemporary witnesses, this documentation traces the dramatic events of the post -war period. The Esterreich-German-Czech co-production with young Europeans tackles the question: What is the relationship between these two countries today? Have the wounds of the past healed? Or threaten to break open in the course of new nationalisms? A film by Matthias Schmidt and Vít Polácek

programme.desc: "Der Tag wird kommen" erzahlt von den hartesten sechs Tagen in der bisherigen Laufbahn der Kommissarin Rosa Roth. Sie wird mit einem Fall konfrontiert, der groSSer und spannender ist als alles, was sie bisher durchgemacht hat. Rosa Roth, allein gegen den Rest der Welt. In einer Berliner Flughafentoilette wird ein Koffer mit bisher unbekannten Patronen aus Kunststoff gefunden, der die Sicherheitsorgane in hochste Alarmbereitschaft versetzt. Diese Munition kann weder ein Metalldetektor noch ein Sprengstoffhund aufspuren, und vor allem: Es muss eine entsprechende Waffe dazu geben. Wer hat sie und wo und wann soll sie eingesetzt werden? Rosa Roth nimmt den Kampf gegen ubermachtige Gegner auf. Zentrale Figuren in diesem Spiel auf Leben und Tod sind Michael Katzmann (Sylvester Groth), ein verurteilter Schwerverbrecher, der eine offene Rechnungmit Rosa Roth hat, der Amsterdamer Waffenhandler Willem van Kleve (Mario Adorf) und der in Paris lebende Araber Nabil (Ingo Hulsmann), der eine Neuordnung der Welt anstrebt. Rosa Roth ahnt nicht, welche Plane sie verfolgen und welche Verbrechen sie vorbereiten. Innerhalb kurzester Zeit steht sie beruflich und privat am Rande des Abgrunds. Die Ereignisse spitzen sich von Tag zu Tag weiter zu.Mit: Iris Berben, Mario Adorf, Ulrich Tukur, Jasmin Tabatabai, Anneke Kim Sarnau,Sylvester Groth, Ingo Hulsmann, Alexander Held, u.a.Regie: Carlo RolaDE 2007 | "The day will come". This ammunition can neither a metal detector nor an explosive dog, and above all: there must be a corresponding weapon. Who has it and where and when should it be used? Rosa Roth takes up the fight against crazy opponents. Rosa Roth has no idea what tarpaulin you are pursuing and what crimes you prepare. Within a short time, she is on the verge of the abyss professionally and privately. programme.title: Erlebnis Buhne LIVE | Experience Buhne Live
programme.sub-title: Aus den Kasematten Graz: La Traviata
programme.desc: Zum bereits vierten Mal ubertragt ORF III live aus der Schlossbergbuhne Kasematten Graz!Das gewohnt prominente Staraufgebot wird auch dieses Jahr geliefert: Mit der US-amerikanischen Sopranistin Nicole Chevalier, dem Wahlosterreicher, Kammersanger und Bariton Thomas Hampson sowie dem spanischen Tenor Xabier Anduaga wird eine "La Traviata" in Traumbesetzung versprochen.Und man darf sich wieder auf Mitglieder der Grazer Philharmoniker sowie Mitglieder des Grazer Opernchors freuen, die von Marcus Merkel dirigiert werden.Die todkranke Pariser Kurtisane Violetta Valery verliebt sich in den jungen Alfredo Germont und gibt fur ihn ihr ausschweifendes Leben auf. Als Alfredos Vater sie bittet, die Beziehung zu beenden, um die Ehre seiner Familie zu retten, opfert Violetta ihr eigenes Gluck und verlasst Alfredo schweren Herzens. Kurz vor ihrem Tod finden die Liebenden noch einmal zueinander, doch Violetta stirbt in Alfredos Armen. | For the fourth time, ORF III transferred live from the Schlossbergbuhne Kasematten Graz! The usual prominent star contingent is also delivered this year: with the American soprano Nicole Chevalier, the Wahlosterreich, Kammersanger and Bariton Thomas Hampson as well as the Spanish tenor Xabier Anduaga, a "La Traviata" will be promised. Back to members of the Graz Philharmonic and members of the Graz opera choir, who are conducted by Marcus Merkel. When Alfredo's father asks her to end the relationship to save the honor of his family, Violetta sacrifices her own happiness and leaves Alfredo with a heavy heart. The lovers find each other again shortly before their death, but Violetta dies in Alfredo's arms.

programme.title: Bohemian Rhapsody | Bohemian Rhapsody
programme.desc: Queen is back! Oscar-gekront schlupft Rami Malek in die Rolle des unvergesslichen Rock-Stars Freddie Mercury. programme.title: FuSSballlegenden - Krankl und Prohaska | Football legends - sick and Prohaska
programme.desc: Hans Krankl und Herbert Prohaska sind osterreichische FuSSball-Legenden. Ihre Geschichte begann als Kicker im Park, fuhrte sie dann als ProfifuSSballer zu Rapid und Austria bevor sie beide zu Spielern in der Nationalmannschaft wurden. Als Trainer gelang beiden eine internationale Karriere. Heute sind sie Kommentatoren mit Kultfaktor. In ihrem Buch "Über das Leben" haben sie, gemeinsam mit ORF-Sportmoderator Rainer Pariasek, ihre Lebensgeschichte erstmals zu Papier gebracht. In Anekdoten erzahlen sie den Wandel des heimischen FuSSballs uber die Jahrzehnte, behandeln aber auch viel Personliches. Robert Altenburger erzahlt die Geschichten der beiden Legenden Krankl und Prohaska. Er hat mit dem ehemaligen ORF-Sportchef Hans Huber, den Moderatoren Alina Zellhofer und Rainer Pariasek uber die Bedeutung der beiden FuSSball-Nationalhelden gesprochen. | Hans Krankl and Herbert Prohaska are Esterreichische Fussball legends. Her story began as a kicker in the park, then she drove to Rapid and Austria as a professional footballer before you both became players in the national team. As a trainer, both achieved an international career. Today they are commentators with a cult factor. In their book "About Life", together with ORF sports moderator Rainer Pariasek, they brought their life story on paper for the first time. In anecdotes, they tell the change in domestic football over the decades, but also treat a lot of personal. Robert Altenburger has the stories of the two legends sick and Prohaska. He spoke to the former ORF sports director Hans Huber, the moderators Alina Zellhofer and Rainer Pariasek about the importance of the two national football heroes.

programme.title: Sportlegenden - Hans Orsolics | Sports legends - Hans Orsolics
programme.desc: Die ORF III-Produktion zeigt das von Hohen und noch mehr Tiefen gepragte Leben der Boxlegende Hans Orsolics: Boxer, Sanger, Kultfigur. "Ein Raufer und Rabauke von Kindesbeinen an" soll er gewesen sein. Aufgewachsen in Ottakring ist seine "Muttersprache nicht Deutsch, sondern Wienerisch". Im Juni 1967 schrieb Hans Orsolics Boxgeschichte: Im Kampf um den Europameistertitel der Europaischen Box Union (EBU) im Halbweltergewicht siegte er in der Wiener Stadthalle gegen den Deutschen Conny Rudhof. Mit knapp 20 Jahren war er der bis dahin jungste europaische Titeltrager. Ein Europameistertitel im Weltergewicht folgte. Eine unnotige k.o. Niederlage in einem Vorbereitungskampf gegen den US-amerikanischen Ex-Weltmeister Eddie Perkins brachte den aufstrebenden Boxer dann jedoch vollig aus dem Tritt. Weitere Niederlagen folgten. Trotz seiner enormen Popularitat und seines unbestreitbaren boxerischen Talents endete seine Sportlerkarriere mit nur 28 Jahren. Fehlinvestitionen und seine zunehmende Alkoholabhangigkeit fuhrten zu seinem beispiellosen sozialen Abstieg. Orsolics, mittlerweile Beisl-Besitzer lieSS sich in unzahlige Raufereien verwickeln und verbrachte insgesamt 846 Tage im Gefangnis. Die Wende brachte 1985 eine ORF-Dokumentation, in der Orsolics groSSe Erfolge seiner tristen Situation gegenubergestellt wurden. Eine Welle der Hilfsbereitschaft folgte und der Wiener Liedermacher Charly Kriechbaum schrieb Orsolics den Hit "Mei potschertes Leben" auf den Leib, der Orsolics an die Spitze der Charts katapultierte. "Auch wenn er viele personliche Niederlagen einstecken musste, lebt Hans Orsolics heute zuruckgezogen und zufrieden", so sein langjahriger Freund Sigi Bergmann.Regisseur Robert Altenburger zeichnet in dieser Dokumentation die Geschichte des bis heute erfolgreichsten osterreichischen Boxers nach, dessen groSSes Talent leider meist von negativen Schlagzeilen uberdeckt wurde. | ORF III production shows the life legend Hans Orsolics: Boxer, Sanger, cult figure, which is even more deep. "A rage and rabade from childhood" he is said to have been. Growing up in Ottakring, his "mother tongue is not German, but Viennese". In June 1967, Hans Orsolics wrote boxing history: In the fight for the European championship title of the European Box Union (EBU) in the semi -world weight, he won against the German Conny Rudhof in the Vienna Stadthalle. At almost 20 years, he was the youngest European title carrier until then. A European championship title followed. An unnecessary knockout Defeat in a preparatory fight against the American ex-world champion Eddie Perkins then brought the emerging boxer out of step completely. Further defeats followed. Despite his enormous popularity and his undeniable boxing talent, his athlete career ended at the age of 28. Misors and its increasing alcohol slope drove to his unprecedented social descent. Orsolics, meanwhile bite owners, could be involved in inensity and spent a total of 846 days in prison. The turn in 1985 brought an ORF documentary, in which Orsolic's great successes of its dreary situation were prepared. A wave of helpfulness followed and the Viennese songwriter Charly Kriechbaum wrote Orsolics the hit "Mei Potscherte's Life", which catapulted orsolics at the top of the charts. "Even if he had to take a lot of personal defeats, Hans Orsolics lives back and satisfied today," said his long -year -old friend Sigi Bergmann. Director Robert Altenburger traces the history of the most successful Austria boxer to date, whose big talent was unfortunately mostly covered by negative headlines.

programme.title: Österreich - Die ganze Geschichte | Austria - the whole story
programme.desc: Der Samen fur manchen Familienreichtum wurde schon fruh gesetzt. Anna Neumann, eine prominente steirische Protestantin, legte mit ihrem Wohlstand die Basis fur die Karriere des Hauses Schwarzenberg. Sie war eine typische Aufsteigerin im Fruhkapitalismus, der im 16. Jahrhundert auch in Österreich Einzug hielt. Folge sechs erzahlt uber die Anfange anhand einiger reicher heimischer Familien, die das erste Mal das Zusammenspiel von Produktion, Markt und Kapital entdeckten, in den Geldverleih einstiegen und sich globale Markte fur ihre Produkte eroberten. Im fruhen 16. Jahrhundert traf der Fruhkapitalismus auf ein anderes bedeutendes historisches Phanomen, die Reformation. Welche Zusammenhange gab es zwischen diesen beiden Bewegungen? Moderation: Andreas Pfeifer und Mariella Gittler, Regie: Valentin Badura | The seed for some family wealth has already been set. Follow six will get into the money rental and conquered global markets for their products on the basis of some rich domestic families who discovered the interaction of production, market and capital for the first time. In the early 16th century, fruh capitalism met another important historical phenomenon, the Reformation. What are the context between these two movements? Moderation: Andreas Pfeifer and Mariella Gittler, directed by Valentin Badura

programme.title: Österreich - Die ganze Geschichte | Austria - the whole story
programme.desc: Wer einmal in die Muhlen der Inquisition geriet, kam kaum je wieder unbeschadet heraus. Eine von vielen, auf die das zutrifft, ist die Mutter des beruhmten Mathematikers Johannes Kepler, Katharina. Durch eine Verleumdung beschuldigt, stand sie Prozess und Folter durch, uberlebte ihren Freispruch aber nur kurz. Es ist nur eine Geschichte von vielen aus der Zeit des dreiSSigjahrigen Krieges, der Europa verheerte und entvolkerte. Rund um Kepler, der in Graz, Linz und Prag gewirkt hat, erzahlt Folge sieben dieser neuen ORFIII-Serie den langen Weg unserer Gesellschaft zu Menschlichkeit und gegenseitiger Toleranz. Aufwandige Spielszenen geben die ganze Dramatik von Keplers Leben wieder und lassen uns in eine Welt eintauchen, die uns zum Gluck heute fremd ist. Moderation: Andreas Pfeifer und Mariella Gittler, Regie: Valentin Badura | Anyone who got into the Inquisition's muels hardly ever came out undamaged. One of many to whom this applies is the mother of the founded mathematician Johannes Kepler, Katharina. Increased by a defamation, she stood through the process and torture, but only briefly survived her acquittal. It is just a story of many from the thirty -year war that devastated and fonded Europe. Around Kepler, who worked in Graz, Linz and Prague, Episode Seven of this new Orfiii series raised the long way of our society to humanity and mutual tolerance. Influent game scenes give the whole drama of Kepler's life again and let us immerse themselves in a world that is strange to us today. Moderation: Andreas Pfeifer and Mariella Gittler, directed by Valentin Badura

programme.title: Österreich - Die ganze Geschichte | Austria - the whole story
programme.desc: Die Pest von 1679 gilt als eine der schwersten Zasuren, die Wien erlitten hat. Über die Hafen und von Sudosten her wurde die Seuche eingeschleppt und forderte mindestens zwolftausend Tote in der Stadt, wahrscheinlich in der Dunkelziffer noch einmal viel mehr. Wahrend das Kaiserhaus mit groSSem Tross nach Mariazell eilte, um dort zu beten - und vermutlich die Seuche dorthin gleich mitbrachte - blieb ein Mann mit umfassender kaiserlicher Vollmacht in Wien, der die ganze Sache richten sollte: der Pestarzt Paul de Sorbait. Sein Wirken kann man radikal und drakonisch nennen, er schreckte auch vor Todesstrafen nicht zuruck, wenn etwa Ärzte Pestleichen plunderten. Aber sein Management brachte es zustande, mit den damaligen Mitteln die Krankheitsausbreitung einzudammen. Es war ein rational gefuhrter Kampf gegen eine Seuche, gegen die die Menschen lange nur auf Glockengelaut und Prozessionen vertraut hatten. Moderation: Andreas Pfeifer und Mariella Gittler, Regie: Maximilian Traxl, Philip Aleksiev | The plague of 1679 is considered one of the heaviest casuals that Vienna suffered. The plague was introduced over the harbor and from Sudosten and demanded at least twelf -thousand dead in the city, probably much more in the number of unreported cases. During the imperial house with a large enthusiasm to pray there to pray - and probably brought the epidemic there - a man with a comprehensive imperial power of attorney remained in Vienna, who was supposed to judge the whole thing: the pestaque Paul de Sorbait. You can call your work radically and draconically, he did not shy away from the death penalty, for example, when doctors puzzled plague corpses. But his management brought about to put on the disease spread with the means at that time. It was a rational struggle against a plague against which people had long only trusted bells and processions. Moderation: Andreas Pfeifer and Mariella Gittler, directed by Maximilian Traxl, Philip Aleksiev
