programme.title: Dober dan, Koroška | Good afternoon, Carinthia
programme.desc: Das Wochenmagazin fur die Karntner Slowenen mit folgenden Themen:Die slowenischen Staatssekretarin fur Auslandsslowenen Vesna Humar hat bei ihrem Besuch auf dem Peršmanhof der slowenischen Volksgruppe ihre volle Unterstutzung bei der Untersuchung der jungsten Polizeirazzia zugesichert. Unterdessen tagte erstmals die Untersuchungskommission mit dem Ziel, die Ursachen und Verantwortlichen dieser PolizeimaSSnahme umfassend zu klaren.HochSommer ist ein grenzuberschreitendes, zeitgenossisches Kunst-Festival. 2025 steht der Generationen ubergreifende Dialog zwischen Stadt und Land im Focus. Mit dabei war auch das Pavelhaus, das Kulturzentrum der steirischen Slowenen.Unter dem Titel "MAAAHD and UNMAAAHD" fand auf der Auwiese in Voh bei St. Jakob im Rosental eine interaktive, multimediale und spartenubergreifende Inszenierung statt, die verschiedene Arbeitsprozesse und Mahmethoden in der Landwirtschaft und den angrenzenden Lebensraumen, deren Effekte und Wandel thematisiert.Der Sommer 2025 ist ein Sommer voller vielfaltiger Aktivitaten und Kreativitat in den Bereichen Musik, Kunst, Sport und Kultur. GroSSer Beliebtheit erfreuen sich der Sommer-Musikworkshop in Tainach, die Woche der jungen Kunstler in Rechberg sowie die Sport- und Sprachenwoche in St. Johann im Rosental.Državna skretarka na uradu vlade Republike Slovenije za Slovence v zamejstvu in po svetu Vesna Humar je na obisku pri Peršmanu slovenski manjšini zagotovila vso podporo pri raziskovanju nedavne policijske racije. Medtem je na notranjem ministrstvu prvic zasedala preiskovalna komisija, ki naj bi celostno preucila vzroke in odgovorne te policijske intervencije.Na jugovzhodnem Štajerskem in v Prekmurju je potekal festival sodobne umetnosti HochSommer. Na petnajstih lokacijah so vabili na rastave, koncerte in performanse v okviru medgeneracijskega dialoga med mestom in podeželjem. programme.title: Österreich - Die ganze Geschichte | Austria - the whole story
programme.desc: Der Spatsommer 1683 hat sich als tiefe Narbe in die Geschichte Wiens eingegraben. Viel hatte nicht gefehlt, und die Kaiserstadt ware dem Expansionsdrang der Osmanen erlegen. Folge neun der neuen ORF III-Serie "Österreich - die ganze Geschichte" widmet sich diesen dramatischen Tagen. Die Dokumentation erzahlt aber auch, was rundherum im Verhaltnis zwischen Österreich und dem Orient passierte. Denn sowohl davor als auch danach gab es einen regen Austausch zwischen West und Ost, und die Faszination fur die osmanische Lebensweise war mindestens so groSS wie die Furcht vor ihrem Expansionsdrang. Die turkische Kultur hat ihre sichtbaren Spuren in der osterreichischen Lebensweise hinterlassen. Vom Kaffee uber das Kipferl bis zum Apfelstrudel ist Vieles nur durch die Durchdringung der westlichen und der ostlichen Lebenswelten erklarbar. Regie: Maximilian Traxl, Philip Aleksiev | The late summer in 1683 was dug up as a deep scar in the history of Vienna. Not much was missing, and the imperial city had been succumbing to the urge to expand of the Ottomans. Follow nine of the new ORF III series "Austria - The whole story" is devoted to these dramatic days. The documentation also reveals what happened all around in the relationship between Austria and the Orient. Because both before and afterwards there was a lively exchange between west and east, and the fascination for the Ottoman lifestyle was at least as great as the fear of its urge to expand. Turkish culture has left its visible traces in the Esterreiche way of life. From coffee over the Kipferl to the apple strudel, a lot can only be explained by the penetration of the western and eastern worlds. Directed by Maximilian Traxl, Philip Aleksiev

programme.title: Österreich - Die ganze Geschichte | Austria - the whole story
programme.desc: Als Franz Hebenstreit nach dem Wiener "Jakobinerprozess" zum Galgen schreitet, ist die Idee, fur die er sterben wird, gerade erst geboren. Mit aller Kraft wehrt sich das Kaiserhaus gegen die Vorstellung, dass das Volk die Macht ubernehmen sollte. Im Gegenteil - mit Reformen festigen Maria Theresia und Joseph II. die Monarchie, die von da ab in Österreich noch eineinhalb Jahrhunderte wahrte. Andreas Pfeifer und Mariella Gittler gehen in Folge zehn von "Österreich - die ganze Geschichte", unterstutzt von umfassenden Spielszenen, an die Wiege unseres heutigen politischen Systems und erzahlen das dramatische Ringen darum. Bis dieser Kampf in die Ausrufung der Republik mundete, dauerte es noch lange. Regie: Maximilian Traxl, Philip Aleksiev | When Franz Hebenstreit goes to the gallows after the Vienna "Jakobin process", the idea for which he will die was just born. The Kaiserhaus defends itself against the idea that the people should take power against the idea. On the contrary - with reforms Maria Theresia and Joseph II are consolidated by the monarchy, which from then on in Austria still maintained one and a half centuries. Andreas Pfeifer and Mariella Gittler go to the cradle of our political system in a row ten of "Austria - The whole History", supports of comprehensive game scenes and tell the dramatic struggle. It took a long time for this fight to be dined out of the republic. Directed by Maximilian Traxl, Philip Aleksiev

programme.title: Das Tal der toten Madchen | The valley of the dead girls
programme.desc: In einem nebligen Tal Nordspaniens wird die Leiche einer Jugendlichen gefunden. Schnell wird klar, dass ein Serienkiller sein Unwesen treibt. Die junge Kommissarin Amaia ermittelt.Es scheint sich um einen Ritualmorder zu handeln, der stets nach dem gleichen Muster verfahrt. Die Leichen werden gereinigt und als Heilige inszeniert. Als ein weiteres Madchen verschwindet, beginnt ein Wettlauf gegen die Zeit.Die spanische Kommissarin Amaia Salazar (Marta Etura) ubernimmt die Ermittlungen in einem bizarren Mordfall: In einem Tal unweit ihres Heimatortes, dem beschaulichen baskischen Stadtchen Elizondo, wird die Leiche einer Jugendlichen gefunden. Sie wurde ausgezogen, rituell gereinigt und von ihrem Morder wie eine Heilige inszeniert auf dem Waldboden platziert. AuSSerdem lag auf ihrem Korper ein traditionelles baskisches Geback - ein Txantxigorri.Dieses Muster passt zu einem Mordfall, der sich bereits einige Wochen zuvor ereignet hat, und Amaia realisiert allmahlich, dass sie es mit einem Serienkiller zu tun hat. Gemeinsam mit ihrem Partner Jonan Etxaide (Carlos Librado Nene) nimmt sie die Ermittlungen auf und kehrt in jenen Ort zuruck, dem sie eigentlich fur immer entfliehen wollte. Doch ihr gefahrlicher Gegner ist ihr stets einen Schritt voraus.Die Medien geben dem geheimnisvollen Killer den Namen Basajaún, ein Waldgeist aus der Mythologie des Baskenlandes. Und einige der Dorfbewohner beginnen tatsachlich, an diese ubernaturliche Erklarung fur die Morde zu glauben. Doch Amaia ist davon uberzeugt, dass es sich um einen Morder aus Fleisch und Blut handelt.Zu allem Überfluss hat Amaia auch noch mit privaten Problemen zu kampfen: Sie vernachlassigt ihren Ehemann James (Benn Northover), mit dem sie sich verzweifelt ein Kind wunscht. Und in Elizondo trifft sie nach vielen Jahren wieder auf ihre alteste Schwester Flora (Elvira Mínguez), die inzwischen das Familienunternehmen leitet und mit der sie im Streit liegt. Flora kann Amaia einfach nicht verzeihen, dass sie sich nicht um die kranke Mutter kummerte, sondern fur ihre Ausbildung einst das Baskenland verlieSS.Als schlieSSlich weitere Madchen verschwinden, beginnt fur Amaia ein Wettlauf gegen die Zeit. Und es wird immer offensichtlicher, dass die Morde auch etwas mit ihrer eigenen Familiengeschichte zu tun haben konnten.Die 1969 geborene Schriftstellerin Dolores Redondo zahlt in ihrem Heimatland Spanien zu den erfolgreichsten Krimiautorinnen. Mit der sogenannten Baztán-Trilogie setzte sie dem Baskenland mit seinen eigenwilligen Bewohnern, verwunschenen Nebeltalern und legendenumrankten Mythen ein literarisches Denkmal. In Deutschland erschienen die Romane unter den Titeln "Ein Echo ferner Tage", "Die vergessenen Kinder" und "Der nachtliche Besucher".Bei diesem Erfolg war es nur eine Frage der Zeit, bis eine Verfilmung der Trilogie geplant wurde. Die Regie fur Teil eins ubernahm Fernando González Molina, der mit dem Historiendrama "Palmen im Schnee" einen groSSen Kinohit in Spanien landete. Auch "El Guardián Invisible" (so der Originaltitel von "Das Tal der toten Madchen"), der in Koproduktion mit dem ZDF und ARTE entstand, wurde zu einem groSSen Erfolg.Die Hauptrolle der couragierten Inspektorin Amaia Salazar, die sich nicht nur mit einem brutalen Serienkiller konfrontiert sieht, sondern auch mit den Damonen ihrer eigenen Vergangenheit, spielt die Baskin Marta Etura, die mit dieser Rolle in ihrem Heimatland schlagartig zum Star wurde. Zwar konnte sie schon an der Seite von Spaniens prominentestem Charakterkopf, Luis Tosar, in den Kinofilmen "Sleep Tight" und "Zelle 211" auf sich aufmerksam machen, doch die Rolle der sensiblen Profilerin schien ihr regelrecht auf den Leib geschrieben zu sein. | The body of a young person is found in a foggy valley of northern Spain. It quickly becomes clear that a serial killer is up to mischief. The young commissioner Amaia determines. The corpses are cleaned and staged as saints. When another girl disappears, a race against time begins. The Spanish commissioner Amaia Salazar (Marta Etura) takes over the investigation in a bizarre murder: in a valley near her hometown, the tranquil Basque town of Elizondo, the body of a young person is found. It was pulled out, cleaned ritually and placed on the forest floor like a saint. In addition, there was a traditional Basque baking on her body - a Txantxigorri. This pattern fits a murder case that occurred a few weeks earlier, and Amaia is gradually realizing that she is dealing with a serial killer. Together with her partner Jonan Etxaide (Carlos Librado Nene), she takes up the investigation and returns to the place that she actually wanted to escape forever. But her dangerous opponent is always one step ahead of her. The media give the mysterious killer the name Basajaún, a forest spirit from the mythology of the Basque Country. And some of the villagers actually begin to believe in this superior explanation for the murders. But Amaia is convinced that it is a murder of flesh and blood. In addition to everything, Amaia also has to get with private problems: she neglects her husband James (Benn Northover), with whom she desperately wishes to do a child. And in Elizondo she meets her oldest sister Flora (Elvira Mínguez) after many years, who now heads the family business and with which she is in a dispute. Flora simply cannot forgive Amaia that she was not grief for the sick mother, but once left the Basque Country for her training. After all, more girls disappear, a race against time begins. And it is becoming more and more obvious that the murders could also have something to do with their own family history. The writer Dolores Redondo, born in 1969, pays the most successful crime writers in her home country of Spain. With the so-called Bazn trilogy, she set a literary monument to the Basque Country with its idiosyncratic residents, enchanted fog valley and legendary myths. In Germany, the novels under the titles "A Echo Ferner Tag", "The Forgotten Children" and "The Night Visit" appeared. With this success, it was only a matter of time before the trilogy was planned. Fernando González Molina, who landed a big cinema in Spain with the historical drama "Palmen in the Snow", was directed by Fernando González Molina. "El Guardián Invisible" (so the original title of "The Valley of the Dead Madchen"), which was created in co -production with ZDF and Arte, became a great success. which suddenly became a star with this role in her home country. Although she was able to draw attention to the side of Spain's most prominent character head, Luis Tosar, in the films "Sleep Tight" and "Cell 211", but the role of the sensitive profiler seemed to be literally written on her body.

programme.title: Wie lange kannst du den Schein noch wahren? | How long can you still keep the appearance?
programme.sub-title: Schamst du dich fur deine Depression?
programme.desc: Christian Durstewitz lebte von seiner Musik. Dann bekam er eine Depression. Er schamte sich, sagte Konzerte ab, erfand Ausreden fur Absagen. Mit Jasmina Neudecker spricht er uber diese Zeit.Ein schrilles Pfeifen im Ohr und das Gefuhl, innerlich tot zu sein. Doch dass er an einer psychischen Erkrankung litt, wollte er nicht glauben. Selbststigma - fast wie eine zweite Krankheit. Wie bauen wir Vorurteile ab und begegnen Betroffenen mit Akzeptanz.Christian Durstewitz konnte nach seinem dritten Platz beim deutschen Vorentscheid zum Eurovision Song Contest 2010 endlich von seiner Musik leben. Doch dann kam der Bruch: Eine schwere Depression riss ihn aus dem Alltag. An Auftritte oder kreative Arbeit war kaum noch zu denken. Aus Angst vor Ablehnung und aus Scham begann Christian, Ausreden zu erfinden, um Konzerte absagen zu konnen- Kopfschmerzen, Magenprobleme - alles war leichter zu erklaren als die wahre Ursache.Biologin Jasmina Neudecker will verstehen, was hinter diesem Gefuhl steckt - einem Gefuhl, das viele Menschen mit psychischen Erkrankungen nur zu gut kennen: Scham. Im Jahr 2022 wurde bei 12,5 Prozent der deutschen Bevolkerung eine Depression diagnostiziert und vielen davon ging es ahnlich wie Christian. Dieses sogenannte Selbststigma macht es Betroffenen noch schwerer, Hilfe anzunehmen und offen uber ihre Situation zu sprechen.Prof. Nicolas Rusch von der Universitatsklinik Ulm nennt das Stigma sogar eine "zweite Krankheit". Denn wahrend korperliche Beschwerden oft Mitgefuhl oder sogar Humor hervorrufen - ein Gipsbein wird schnell zur Partygeschichte - bleibt ein Aufenthalt in der Psychiatrie meist ein Tabu. Wie also konnen wir Vorurteile abbauen und psychische Erkrankungen mit der gleichen Offenheit begegnen wie korperlichen Leiden? | Christian Durstewitz lived from his music. Then he got a depression. He shaped himself, said concerts, invented excuses for canceling. He speaks to Jasmina Neudecker about this time. A shrill whistle in the ear and the feeling of being dead inside. But he didn't want to believe that he suffered from a mental illness. Self -level - almost like a second illness. How do we break down prejudices and meet those affected with acceptance. But then the break came: a severe depression tore him out of everyday life. There was hard to think about appearances or creative work. For fear of rejection and out of shame, Christian began to tell excuses to cancel concerts - headache, stomach problems - everything was easier to explain than the true cause. Biologist Jasmina Neudecker wants to understand what is behind this feeling - a feel that many people with mental illnesses know too well: shame. In 2022, depression was diagnosed in 12.5 percent of German population and many of them were similar to Christian. This so -called self -sigma makes it even more difficult to accept help and to speak openly about their situation. Nicolas Rusch from the Ulm University Clinic even calls a "second illness". Because while boring symptoms often cause fellow chair or even humor - a plaster leg quickly becomes a party history - a stay in psychiatry usually remains a taboo. So how can we dismantle prejudices and encounter mental illnesses with the same openness as corporate suffering?

Wie bauen wir Vorurteile ab und begegnen Betroffenen mit Akzeptanz.Christian Durstewitz konnte nach seinem dritten Platz beim deutschen Vorentscheid zum Eurovision Song Contest 2010 endlich von seiner Musik leben. Aus Angst vor Ablehnung und aus Scham begann Christian, Ausreden zu erfinden, um Konzerte absagen zu konnen- Kopfschmerzen, Magenprobleme - alles war leichter zu erklaren als die wahre Ursache.Biologin Jasmina Neudecker will verstehen, was hinter diesem Gefuhl steckt - einem Gefuhl, das viele Menschen mit psychischen Erkrankungen nur zu gut kennen: Scham. Denn wahrend korperliche Beschwerden oft Mitgefuhl oder sogar Humor hervorrufen - ein Gipsbein wird schnell zur Partygeschichte - bleibt ein Aufenthalt in der Psychiatrie meist ein Tabu. programme.title: Mord im Mittsommer | Murder in Mids summer
programme.desc: Die sterblichen Überreste von zwei Jugendlichen, die 30 Jahre zuvor bei einer Konfirmandenfreizeit verschwunden sind, werden entdeckt. Was ist mit der ebenfalls vermissten Esther passiert?Alexander und Welpe versuchen, die Geschehnisse von damals zu rekonstruieren. Bei ihren Recherchen stoSSen sie auf bekannte Gesichter: Staatsanwaltin Nora und ihr heutiger Ex-Mann Henrik haben damals bei dem Kirchencamp eine wichtige Rolle gespielt.Bei einer Konfirmandenfreizeit entdecken Jugendliche im Wald einen Erdkeller, in dem zwei Skelette liegen. Kommissar Alexander (Nicolai Cleve Broch) und sein Kollege Welpe (Julius Fleischanderl) werden zur Fundstelle beordert. Es stellt sich heraus, dass es sich bei den Toten um die Jugendlichen Johan und Petter handelt, die wahrend eines Kirchencamps 30 Jahre zuvor plotzlich spurlos verschwunden waren. Auch eine dritte Person wird seitdem vermisst: Esther, die Tochter von Pfarrer Arne (Henrik Norlen) und dessen Frau Iris (Charlotta Jonsson).Zu ihrer Überraschung entdecken Alexander und Welpe auf einem Gruppenfoto von der Konfirmandenfreizeit des Jahres 1992 bekannte Gesichter: Staatsanwaltin Nora (Alexandra Rapaport) und ihr heutiger Ex-Mann Henrik (Jonas Malmsjo) waren damals als Leiter - und heimliches Liebespaar - mit dabei.Als die beiden mit der Polizei uber die lang zuruckliegenden Vorfalle sprechen, kommt heraus, dass Henrik auch damals schon mit seiner heutigen Gattin Gisela (Yasmine Garbi) geflirtet hat. Nora rauscht wutentbrannt ab, wahrend Henrik doch noch etwas Konstruktives zu den Ermittlungen beitragt: Er erinnert sich daran, dass Esther zum Zeitpunkt ihres Verschwindens womoglich schwanger war.Wenig spater wird Iris tot aufgefunden. Auf Bildern einer Überwachungskamera ist zu sehen, dass der mittlerweile getrennt von ihr lebende Arne sie besucht hat. Kurz darauf war offenbar auch der ehemalige Jugendpastor Josef (Per Lasson) bei ihr. Was haben die beiden Manner mit Iris Tod zu tun?Unterdessen werden in ihrem Nachlass Briefe entdeckt, die Esthers Verschwinden in einem vollig neuen Licht erscheinen lassen. | The remains of two young people who have disappeared 30 years earlier during a confirmation leisure time are discovered. What happened to the also missing Esther? Alexander and puppy try to reconstruct the events of that time. In their research, they encounter well-known faces: Prosecutor Nora and her today's ex-husband Henrik played an important role in the church camp. On a confirmation freedom, young people discover an earth cellar in which two skeletons are located. Commissioner Alexander (Nicolai Cleve Broch) and his colleague puppy (Julius Fleischanderl) are ordered to the site. It turns out that the dead are the youngsters Johan and Petter, who had suddenly disappeared during a church camp 30 years earlier. A third person has also been missed since then: Esther, the daughter of Pastor Arne (Henrik Norlen) and his wife Iris (Charlotta Jonsson). Nora rushes off, while Henrik still contributes something constructive to the investigation: he remembers that Esther was possibly pregnant at the time of her disappearance. It can be seen in pictures of a surveillance camera that the Arne, who has now lived separately, has visited her. programme.title: The Tourist - Duell im Outback | The Tourist - Duel in Outback
programme.desc: Der Fremde entdeckt sein Handy, das er vor dem Unfall an einer Tankstelle versteckt hatte. Prompt erhalt er einen Anruf von einem Mann - es ist ein verzweifelter Hilferuf.Der Fremde musse ihm helfen, fleht der Mann ihn an. Denn er sei irgendwo in einem Ölfass vergraben, und jemand musse kommen und ihn befreien. Er kann noch einen vagen Hinweis geben, wo der Fremde ihn suchen soll, dann gibt der Akku seines Handys den Geist auf.Da die wenigsten Ölfasser, die irgendwo herumstehen, heutzutage mit USB-Anschlussen geschweige denn Ladekabeln ausgestattet sind, ist mit einer erneuten Kontaktaufnahme des unglucklich Eingeschlossenen eher nicht zu rechnen. Daher erklart sich Kellnerin Luci (Shalom Brune-Franklin) kurzerhand bereit, den Fremden (Jamie Dornan) nach Murray Waters zu fahren - den Ort, an den sich der eingegrabene Mann noch erinnern konnte.Dort finden sie tatsachlich einen Piloten, der sie mit dem Helikopter zu der Stelle bringen will, wo der Mann moglicherweise vergraben ist. Der Fremde hofft nicht nur, das Leben des Mannes retten zu konnen, sondern auch etwas uber sich selbst zu erfahren - schlieSSlich schien der Mann ihn zu kennen.Wahrenddessen nimmt Detective Inspector Lachlan Rogers (Damon Herriman) in Burnt Ridge die Ermittlungen nach der Explosion in dem Diner auf. Gemeinsam mit dem jungen, etwas ubereifrigen lokalen Polizisten Sergeant Lammon (Kamil Ellis) macht er sich ebenfalls auf den Weg nach Murray Waters, um den Fremden ohne Namen zu finden.Verkehrspolizistin in Probezeit Helen (Danielle Macdonald) lasst die Sache mit dem Unbekannten nicht los. Sie hat das Gefuhl, etwas tun zu mussen, und fangt auf eigene Faust an, zu ermitteln. He promptly receives a call from a man - it is a desperate call for help. The stranger must help him, the man begs him. programme.desc: ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Επεισόδιο: Νάξος. Η Πηνελόπη και ο Γιάννης φτάνουν στη Νάξο, τη βασίλισσα των Κυκλάδων. Υπέροχα πεντακάθαρα νερά, παραλίες για όλα τα γούστα, χωριά βγαλμένα σαν από παραμύθι, ξεχωριστό παραδοσιακό φαγητό από πρώτης ποιότητας πρώτες ύλες, μοναδικά τοπικά προϊόντα ΠΟΠ, νυχτερινή ζωή, αρχαιολογικό ενδιαφέρον. | PREMIERE. Wonderful crystal clear waters, beaches for all tastes, villages made as a fairy tale, a distinctive traditional food from raw materials, unique local pop products, nightlife, archaeological interest.

programme.title: Ζακέτα να Πάρεις Κ2 Ε2 (Ε) | Jacket to get K2 E2 (E)
programme.desc: Επεισόδιο: Διαζύγιο α λα Φούλη. Οι γονείς της Ευγενίας, η Βέτα και ο Αγησίλαος, καταφτάνουν στην Αθήνα, αποφασισμένοι να υπογράψουν το διαζύγιό τους. Ο αυστηρός στρατιωτικός και η επαναστατημένη σύζυγος δεν αντέχουν ο ένας τον άλλον και οι καβγάδες ξεκινούν αμέσως. | Episode: Divorce A La Fouli. Eugenia's parents, Beta and Agisilaos arrive in Athens, determined to sign their divorce. The strict military and the rebellious husband do not stand up to each other and the quarrels start immediately.

Αν και η διαδικασία διαφέρει σημαντικά από είδος σε είδος, οι αρχιτέκτονες της φύσης κρατούν μυστικά που εμείς μόνο ονειρευόμαστε να ξεκλειδώσουμε. | Episode: The builders. Creating and constructing for centuries, people are not the only animals made to build. Although the process is significantly different from species in kind, the architects of nature keep secrets that we only dream of unlocking.

programme.title: Aftersun | Aftersun
programme.desc: Η 11χρονη Σόφι περνά με τον χωρισμένο πατέρα της ξένοιαστες ημέρες διακοπών σε κάποιο θέρετρο της Τουρκίας. Είκοσι χρόνια μετά, επαναφέρει στη μνήμη της στιγμές αυτού του σημαντικού ταξιδιού... Η ταινία ήταν υποψήφια για Όσκαρ. (98) | The 11 -year -old Sophie spends her father -in -house holiday days at a Turkish resort. Twenty years later, it brings back to memory of this important journey ... The film was an Oscar nominee. (98)

programme.title: Μικρές Ιστορίες | Small stories
programme.desc: Δεντρολίβανος ο φαρμακευτής. Καλοκαίρι στην Κρήτη. Ένας γέροντας συναντά ένα νεαρό ζευγάρι. Θα τους αποκαλύψει τα μυστικά του κύκλου της ζωής μέσα από τη δύναμη της φύσης. Η πορεία τους αλλάζει για πάντα. Μπορεί το ίδιο βότανο να χαρίσει ζωή μα και να καταστρέψει; | Rosemary the medicinal. Summer in Crete. An elder meets a young couple. He will reveal to them the secrets of the cycle of life through the power of nature. Their course changes forever. Can the same herb give life and destroy?

programme.title: Τρέχει ο Ιδρώτας Ε5 (Ε) | Runs the sweat e5 (e)
programme.desc: Επεισόδιο: Τουρκία. Εκεί όπου η κοσμοπολίτικη ζωή αναμειγνύεται με τα απομεινάρια της Οθωμανικής Αυτοκρατορίας, η Ελίζαμπετ Κουρουμλού ξεναγεί τον Μίκελ στους δρόμους της Κωνσταντινούπολης, της Προύσας και όχι μόνο. | Episode: Turkey. Where cosmopolitan life blends with the remnants of the Ottoman Empire, Elizabeth Kourumlou guides Michael to the streets of Constantinople, Bursa and beyond.

programme.desc: Επεισόδιο: Παντελερία. Ολοκληρώνουμε το ταξίδι στο νησί Παντελερία στα ανοιχτά της Μεσογείου, το οποίο βρίσκεται πιο κοντά στην Τυνησία παρά στην Ιταλία. | Episode: Panteleria. We complete the trip to the island of Panteleria off the Mediterranean, which is closest to Tunisia than to Italy.

programme.title: Κυριακή στο Χωριό Ξανά (Ε) | Sunday in the village again (e)
programme.desc: Επεισόδιο: Νέα Πέραμος Καβάλας. Ολοκαίνουργια ιδέα πάνω στην παραδοσιακή εκπομπή. Brand new idea on traditional show. The village remains the protagonist, the people who inhabit it, their lives, the way they reproduce their traditions, everything they have achieved in time and everything they dream of.

programme.title: Συν-Άνθρωποι Κ4 Ε4 (Ε) | Co-human beings K4 E4 (E)
programme.desc: Επεισόδιο: Επειδή δεν Eίναι Όλα Κέρδος. Ο Γιάννης Δάρρας επισκέπτεται τη Χάλκη για να συναντήσει την ομάδα των ανθρώπων που αποφάσισαν να επιστρέψουν. Γιατί η Χάλκη είναι τόπος με ρίζες βαθιές και δεν δέχονται να τη βλέπουν να μαραζώνει όταν σβήνουν τα φώτα του τουρισμού. | Episode: Because it's not all profit. Giannis Darras visits Halki to meet the team of people who have decided to return. Because Halki is a place with deep roots and refuses to see her wither when the tourism lights are turned off.

programme.title: Η Ιστορία της Βροχής Ε3 (Ε) | The History of Rain E3 (E)
programme.desc: Επεισόδιο: Η Αξία της Βροχής. Η ζωή στη Γη δεν θα ήταν δυνατή χωρίς βροχή. Αν και το νερό καλύπτει το μεγαλύτερο μέρος της γης, το 97% του είναι θαλασσινό. Η βροχή υποστηρίζει τη ζωή στη στεριά παρέχοντας νερό χωρίς αλάτι που μπορούμε να πιούμε. | Episode: The value of the rain. Life on Earth would not be possible without rain. Although water covers most of the earth, 97% of it is seafood. The rain supports life on land by providing salt -free water that we can drink.

programme.title: Το Ταξίδι μου στην Ελλάδα Κ4 Ε5 (Ε) | My trip to Greece K4 E5 (E)
programme.desc: Επεισόδιο: Χάλκη - Κάρπαθος. Η Χάλκη είναι από εκείνα τα πανέμορφα νησιά που παραμένουν άγνωστα στο ευρύ κοινό. Ο Πίτερ Μανέας μάς ξεναγεί σε αυτό τον τόπο των αντιθέσεων, προτού βάλει πλώρη για την Κάρπαθο, το δεύτερο μεγαλύτερο νησί των Δωδεκανήσων. | Episode: Halki - Karpathos. Halki is one of those beautiful islands that remain unknown to the general public. Peter Manas guides us to this place of contrasts, before he sets a bow for Karpathos, the second largest island of the Dodecanese.

programme.title: Βόρεια Χιλή: Ανάμεσα στις Άνδεις και τον Ειρηνικό | North Chile: Between the Andes and the Pacific
programme.desc: ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Η Βόρεια Χιλή είναι μια περιοχή ακραίων συνθηκών. Από την Ατακάμα, μια από τις ξηρότερες και παλαιότερες ερήμους της γης, στο ρεύμα Χούμπολντ στα ανοικτά των ακτών της που δημιουργεί έναν συναρπαστικό πλούτο θαλάσσιων οικοσυστημάτων. | PREMIERE. North Chile is an area of extreme conditions. From Atacama, one of the drier and oldest deserts on Earth, on the Humbold Stream off its coasts that creates a fascinating wealth of marine ecosystems.

programme.title: Κόντρα στην Κλιματική Κρίση Ε1 (Ε) | Against Climate Crisis E1 (E)
programme.desc: Επεισόδιο: Αντίσταση. Η κλιματική απορρύθμιση κλιμακώνεται, όπως το απέδειξαν πρόσφατα γεγονότα (ξηρασίες, πυρκαγιές...) Πώς να προετοιμαστούμε γι αυτό το αναπόφευκτο σοκ; Ποιες οι λύσεις μεγάλης εμβέλειας για να μπορέσουμε να χτίσουμε τον κόσμο του αύριο; | Episode: Resistance. Climate deregulation escalates, as recent events have shown it (droughts, fires ...) How to prepare for this inevitable shock? What are the large -scale solutions so that we can build the world of tomorrow?

programme.title: Igram svoju igru | I play my game
programme.desc: Serijal namijenjen našoj najmlađoj populaciji koncipiran je da popularizuje i propagira zdrav način života kroz sport i pravilnu ishranu. Epizode namijenjene djeci koje se bave sportom, nebitno na kom nivou uspjeha, prikazaće suštinske prednosti koje pružaju sport i pravilna ishrana. Mišljenja smo da u Crnoj Gori ima mnogo talentovane djece koja nemaju adekvatne uslove za razvoj njihovog talenta. Serijal bi bio skroman inicijator da se trenutna situacija podigne na bar za jednu stepenicu veći nivo. Želimo da skrenemo pažnju na potencijal koji pripada samo nama, koji je neosporan, potencijal koji zaslužuje mnogo više. | The series intended for our youngest population is conceived to popularize and propagate a healthy lifestyle through sports and proper nutrition. Episodes intended for children engaged in sports, irrelevant at which success level, will show the essential advantages that provide sports and proper nutrition. We are of the opinion that in Montenegro has many talented children who do not have adequate conditions for the development of their talent. The series would be a modest initiator to raise the current situation on a bar for one step higher level. programme.title: Nova Vida, Nova Esperança: As Especies em Perigo da Península de Otago | New Life, New Hope: the species in danger of the Otago Peninsula
programme.desc: O delicado equilíbrio da natureza está em evidencia na Península de Otago, na Nova Zelândia, onde a vida selvagem e as pessoas vivem em estreita proximidade. O pinguim-de-olhos-amarelos e o leao-marinho-da-Nova-Zelândia, ambos em perigo de extinçao, criam os seus filhotes em florestas distantes da costa. O ameaçado albatroz-real-do-norte agora desfruta das condições ideais para os seus rituais de acasalamento turbulentos e a consequente criaçao dos filhotes no promontorio ventoso e coberto de ervas. Medidas de conservaçao tambem apoiam os esforços destes animais para aumentar o seu número populacional. | The delicate balance of nature is evident in the Otago Peninsula, New Zealand, where wildlife and people live closely proximity. The yellow-leather penguin and the-nox-nosy-navy-nava-nose, both in danger of extinction, create their puppies in forests distant from the coast. The threatened Albatroz-Real-do-North now enjoys the ideal conditions for his turbulent mating rituals and the consequent creation of the puppies in the sunsent and herb-covered promotion. Conservation measures also support the efforts of these animals to increase their population number.

programme.title: MMA UFC 40 | Beauty UFC 40
programme.desc: Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua. | The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu.

programme.title: MMA UFC 10 | Beauty UFC 10
programme.desc: Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua. | The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu.

programme.title: MMA UFC 274 | Beauty UFC 274
programme.desc: Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua. | The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu.

programme.title: Košarka - Turska liga: Tofas - Bahcesehir, G3

programme.title: Košarka - Euroleague: Partizan - Real Madrid
programme.desc: Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. U ligi se takmiči 18 ekipa koje u regularnom delu sezone međusobno odigraju po dve utakmice. Nakon 34 odigrana kola osam najboljih ekipa ulazi u plej of i borbu za titulu prvaka Francuske. Ekipa sa najviše osvojenih titula je ASVEL.

programme.title: Košarka - Italijanska liga: Trapani - Brescia, polufinale G2

Ova liga ima veliki značaj za evropsku klupsku košarku kao liga koja je dala preko 35 naslova njenih klubova u evropskim takmičenjima počevši od Evrolige, FIBA Saporta Kupa i Kupa Radivoja Koraća. programme.title: Košarka - Francuska liga: Lyon - Monaco, polufinale G2
programme.desc: Takmičenje najvišeg ranga klupske košarke u Francuskoj naziva se LNB Pro A. Liga je osnovana 1921. godine koja je kroz istoriju više puta menjala svoj naziv. U ligi se takmiči 18 ekipa koje u regularnom delu sezone međusobno odigraju po dve utakmice. Nakon 34 odigrana kola osam najboljih ekipa ulazi u plej of i borbu za titulu prvaka Francuske. Ekipa sa najviše osvojenih titula je ASVEL.

programme.title: Mi živimo za košarku | We live for basketball
programme.desc: Pođite sa nama na putovanje i saznajte nešto više o domaćim košarkaškim klubovima koji daju sve od sebe kako bi ostvarili što bolji plasman u ligama u kojima se takmiče.

programme.title: Košarka - Italijanska liga: Virtus - Armani, polufinale G2
programme.desc: Dugogodišnja istorija italijanske Lega Basket Serie A datira još do davne 1920. i njenog osivanja. Prvi pobednik je bila ekipa Kostance iste te 1920. godine. Ova liga ima veliki značaj za evropsku klupsku košarku kao liga koja je dala preko 35 naslova njenih klubova u evropskim takmičenjima počevši od Evrolige, FIBA Saporta Kupa i Kupa Radivoja Koraća. Samo takmičenje se sastoji od 30 utakmica koju svaka ekipa igra protiv 15 protivnika dvokružno, nakon čega sledi plejof od osam ekipa. Eliminacione utakmice se igraju na četiri dobijene utakmice od sedam ili engleska terminologija Best of seven.

programme.title: Košarka - Španska liga: Manresa - Real Madrid
programme.desc: Španska košarkaška liga osnovana je 1957. godine kao Liga National te je današnji format dobila 1983. godine kada organizacija ACB preuzima kontrolu nad takmičenjem. Prema bodovanju, Liga ACB jedna je od tri najbolje evropske lige. Trenutno u ligi sudeluje 18 ekipa koje u toku sezone po dva puta igraju međusobno. Ekipa sa najviše osvojenih titula je madridski Real ali u stopu ga prati i Barselona. Španska liga kroz istoriju nam je dala neke od najvećih svetskih igrača i trenera.

programme.title: Košarka - FIBA Liga šampiona: Igokea - Wurzburg
programme.desc: Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina Basketball Champions League. Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji Euroleague Basketball S.L. i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajbal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: Košarka - Turska liga: Fenerbahce - Manisa
programme.desc: Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko pre osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plejof osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Košarka - Nemačka liga: Ulm - Bayern, finale G2
programme.desc: Istorija nemačke klupske košarke datira još iz 1939. godine, no Nemačka košarkaška Bundesliga osnovana je 1964. godine dok samo takmičenje je krenulo dve godine kasnije. Takmičenje se sastoji od 18 timova, a sezona je podeljena na regularni deo u kojem svako igra sa svakim dvokružno i plejof deo koji stupa nakon završenog regularnog dela. Poslednje dve ekipe regularnog dela ispadaju u niži rang, dok se u plejofu pobednik dobija Best of five formatu gdje ekipe moraju dobiti minmalno 3 utakmice od 5 kako bi izbacili rivala. programme.title: Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Široki Brijeg - Velež
programme.desc: Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Košarka - ABA liga: Igokea - Mornar
programme.desc: ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone. | The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season.

programme.title: Košarka - ABA liga: Dubai - Borac
programme.desc: ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone. | The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season.

programme.title: Dinastija | Dynasty
programme.desc: Mogočen naftni mogotec Blake Carrington se pripravlja na poroko z mlado Krystle Jennings, svojo nekdanjo tajnico. Her only ally is Black's son, Steven, who, however, does not understand with her father, because of his different political views.

programme.desc: Od leta 2021 bodo nogometni navdušenci uživali v Konferenčni ligi Evrope, ki jo organizira UEFA. Ideja za to ligo se je pojavila leta 2015, vključuje pa nižje rangirane ekipe državnih prvenstev. Kvalifikacije so razdeljene na dva dela, po katerih bo v tekmovanje vstopilo 32 ekip, ki bodo razdeljene v osem skupin po štiri. 16 ekip bo napredovalo v osmino finala, nato v četrtfinale, polfinale in finale. Zmagovalec finalne tekme se bo uvrstil v Ligo Evrope v naslednji sezoni. | Since 2021, football fans will enjoy the conference league of Europe organized by UEFA. The idea for this league appeared in 2015 and includes a lower ranked team of national championships. The qualifications are divided into two parts, after which 32 teams will enter the competition, which will be divided into eight groups of four each. 16 teams will advance to the eighth finals, then to the quarterfinals, the semifinals and the finals. The winner of the final game will qualify for the European League next season.

programme.title: Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Koper, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Kolesarstvo: Dirka po Češki, 4. etapa: Kromeriz, Velke namesti - Pustevny (179 km)
programme.desc: Samo nekaj dni po vrhuncu kolesarske sezone v Franciji, so pred kolesarji že novi izzivi. Del karavane se bo preselil na Češko, kjer se obeta napeto dirkanje od prvega do zadnjega kilometra. Pred letom dni se je zmage veselil član Bore Florian Lipowitz.

programme.title: Pričevalci: Stanislava Wagener Škrabl, 1.del, pon. | Witnesses: Stanislava Wagener Škrabl, 1st, Mon.
programme.desc: Stanislava Škrabl, poročena Wagener, danes živi v Izoli, kjer ji družbo delata samosvoji, mačji kosmatinki. V prvem delu spoznamo pričevalkino družino. Njena mama je bila aristokratskega rodu, izobraževala se je za operno pevko in redno nastopala v Celju. Tam je spoznala očeta, ki je odlično igral na harmoniko. Zaposlen je bil pri urarju Lečniku v Celju. V času nemške okupacije je delal za partizane. Nato so ga odkrili in poslali na prisilno delo v Nemčijo. Od tam je pobegnil v partizane, za njim je odšla tudi mama z otroki. | Stanislava Škrabl, married Wagener, today lives in Izola, where her society is made by her own, cat hair. In the first part we get to know the witness's family. Her mother was aristocratic descent, she was educated for an opera singer and regularly performed in Celje. There she met her father, who played perfectly on the accordion. He was employed at the watchmaker Lecnik in Celje. During the German occupation, he worked for the partisans. He was then discovered and sent for forced work in Germany. From there he escaped to the partisans, followed by his mother with children.

programme.title: Cankar, dokumentarno igrani film, pon. | Cankar, documentary feature film, Mon.
programme.sub-title: Dokumentarno-igrani film Cankar nam v igranih prizorih približa zasebno življenje največjega slovenskega pisatelja.
programme.desc: Filmska pripoved se začne novembra 1899, ko Ivan Cankar najame kabinet pri družini Loffler v dunajskem predmestju Ottakring. Sprva se približa gospodinji, pozneje pa njeni odraščajoči hčeri Steffi. Pri njih se ustali za skoraj deset let in tam ustvari večino svojih del.Ob obisku brata Karla v Sarajevu je gost nadškofa Josipa Stadlerja. Tam napiše Hlapce in se odloči, da se ne bo vrnil k zaročenki na Dunaj. Naslednja leta živi na ljubljanskem Rožniku. Tudi tam se zapleta s tamkajšnjimi dekleti; je pozoren ljubimec, družaben in izjemno inteligenten.Opazuje bedo obubožanega delavskega razreda okoli sebe in se navduši za socialdemokracijo. Upor proti krivičnemu družbenemu redu preveva celoten Cankarjev opus. Z rekonstrukcijami nekaterih javnih nastopov v filmu je poudarjena moč in aktualnost njegove politične besede.Pozorno branje Cankarjevih del nam razkriva podrobnosti iz pisateljevega življenja. V njegovih skoraj filmskih opisih prepoznavamo prostore, portrete najbližjih in sodobnikov. Marsikaj, kar je opisal v literaturi, je nekaj let pozneje tudi sam doživel. V premišljenih prepletih igranega, animiranega in dokumentarnega so rokopisi in pisma iz njegove zapuščine vtkani v igrane prizore. Junaki v filmu spregovorijo z besedami iz Cankarjeve proze.Film odpira vprašanje, kako se je v dobrem stoletju izoblikoval mit o Ivanu Cankarju. Veličasten opus romanov, povesti, črtic, pesmi, esejev, političnih govorov, člankov in pisem ponuja široko polje interpretacij. Cankarja so si prisvajali tako na levici kot na desnici. V dokumentarnem delu filma se srečujemo s poznavalci, ki strastno razkrivajo prezrte plati pisateljevega dela. Prepričani smo, da smo o Cankarju v dobrem stoletju izvedeli vse, vendar njegovo delo v resnici le površno poznamo. | The film narrative begins in November 1899, when Ivan Cankar hires a cabinet on the Loffler family in the Vienna suburb of Ottakring. At first she approaches the gentlemen, and later her growing daughters Steffi. They have settled down for almost ten years and creates most of his works there. On his visit to his brother Karl in Sarajevo, he is the guest of Archbishop Josip Stadler. He writes the servants there and decides not to return to the fiancé in Vienna. The following years he lives on Ljubljana Rožnik. He also gets involved with the girls there; He is an attentive lover, sociable and extremely intelligent. It fools the misery of an impoverished working class around him and is impressed for social democracy. The rebellion against the criminal social order is translated by the entire Cankar's oeuvre. The reconstructions of some public appearances in the film emphasizes the power and actuality of his political word. In terms of reading Cankar's works, he reveals details from the writer's life. In his almost film descriptions, we recognize the spaces, portraits of loved ones and contemporaries. Many of what he described in the literature had experienced a few years later. In the thoughtful interweaving of playful, animated and documentary, manuscripts and letters from his legacy are woven into play scenes. The heroes in the film speak with words from Cankar's prose. The Film raises the question of how the myth of Ivan Cankar has formed in a good century. The magnificent oeuvre of novels, stories, lines, poems, essays, political speeches, articles and letters offers a wide field of interpretations. Cankar was appropriated both on the left and right. In the documentary, we face connoisseurs who passionately reveal the overlooked side of the writer's work. We are convinced that we have learned everything about Cankar in a good century, but we really only know his work superficially.

programme.title: Imago Sloveniae: Barcelona Gipsy Klezmer Orchestra in Vlado Kreslin, pon. | Imago Sloveniae: Barcelona Gipsy Klezmer Orchestra and Vlado Kreslin, Mon.
programme.desc: R: Menart Urška... Velika družina nomadskih glasbenikov, ki prihajajo iz različnih držav Evrope (Katalonija,Turčija, Srbija, Indija, Italija, Francija, Švica, Grčija), se je srečala v Barceloni leta 2010. Izhodišče njihovega skupnega ustvarjanja so bila glasbena druženja, na katerih so v improviziranem igranju združevali in delili svojo strast do tradicionalne judovske in romske glasbe, v katero so vnašali strokovno znanje in vplive drugih glasbenih zvrsti. To je med njimi stkalo močne ustvarjalne vezi, na podlagi katerih se je oblikovala skupina Barcelona Gipsy Klezmer Orchestra (BGKO). Z odličnimi interpretacijami in energijo, ki jo širijo med občinstvo, navdušujejo na najrazličnejših glasbenih prizoriščih po Evropi. Prinesli so jo tudi na Mestni trg Ljubljane leta 2013 ob odprtju 25. Noči v Stari Ljubljani, ki jih pripravlja ustanova Imago Sloveniae – Podoba Slovenije. Na odru se jim je kot gost pridružil eden največjih slovenskih kantavtorjev, Vlado Kreslin! | R: Menart Urška ... A large family of nomadic musicians coming from different countries of Europe (Catalonia, Turkey, Serbia, India, Italy, France, Switzerland, Greece) met in Barcelona in 2010. Introduce expertise and influences of other music genres. This made strong creative bonds between them, on the basis of which the Barcelona Gipsy Klezmer Orchestra (BGKO) was formed. With excellent interpretations and energy spreading among the audience, they are impressed by a wide variety of music venues across Europe. It was also brought to the City Square of Ljubljana in 2013 at the opening of the 25th night in Old Ljubljana, prepared by the Imago Sloveniae Foundation - the image of Slovenia. As a guest, one of the greatest Slovenian singers, Vlado Kreslin, joined them on stage!

programme.title: Reverz, dokumentarni film, pon. | Reverse, documentary film, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Frelih Anton... Po drugi svetovni vojni je Slovenija sprejela odlok o ustanovitvi Federalnega zbirnega centra.
programme.desc: Posebne komisije so po deželi »odbirale« vredne predmete (umetniške slike in kipe, antično pohištvo, preproge, porcelan, glasbila in drugo). V Ljubljani je delovala centrala zbirnega centra s tremi skladišči, po Sloveniji pa še tri področne izpostave, v Celju, Mariboru in Novem mestu. Šlo je za obliko nacionalizacije, ki jo je takratna oblast pospremila z opravičilom, da jemlje vojni zločincem in da na ta način zagotavlja ohranitev teh predmetov v Sloveniji. Toda veliko predmetov je bilo vzetih prebivalcem Slovenije s povsem »čisto« vojno preteklostjo, le imeli so preveč za takratne pojme. Tako je bil izgovor, da z nacionalizacijo ohranjajo kulturno dediščino v Sloveniji, precej prazen. Zasebna lastnina je bila grobo poteptana. Del tako zaplenjenih predmetov je dokumentirano končal v takratnih vladnih in ministrskih prostorih , umetniških galerijah, muzejih in šolah, precejšen del predmetov pa je končal v rokah pomembnih, za takratni čas zaslužnih posameznikov, ki so bili v vrhu politične strukture.Danes lahko pretežni del dokumentacije o ustanovitvi in delovanju Federalnega zbirnega centra ter o zaplenjenih predmetih najdemo v Arhivu Republike Slovenije. Scenarist in režiser dokumentarnega filma je Tone Frelih. | Special commissions have "selected" valuable objects (art paintings and statues, ancient furniture, carpets, porcelain, instruments and more) throughout the country. In Ljubljana, a collection center with three warehouses operated in Ljubljana, and three more area branches in Celje, Maribor and Novo mesto. It was a form of nationalization, which at that time was accompanied by an apology that he was taking war criminals and thus ensuring the preservation of these objects in Slovenia. But many objects were taken by the people of Slovenia with a purely "clear" war of the past, only they had too much for the concepts of the time. Thus, the excuse to preserve the cultural heritage in Slovenia by nationalization was quite empty. Private property was roughly trampled. He finished some of the confiscated subjects in the then government and ministerial premises, art galleries, museums and schools, and ended up a considerable part of the subjects in the hands of important, for the time of the deserving individuals who were at the top of the political structure. The screenwriter and director of the documentary is Tone Frelih.

Nepozabna je sekvenca, v kateri se Steven Wright in Roberto Benigni živahno pogovarjata, ne da bi drug drugega razumela. Iggy Pop in Tom Waits praznujeta svoje prenehanje kajenja s kajenjem cigaret in komentirata glasbeno slavo. Raperja GZA in RZA natakarja Billa Murrayja prepričujeta o nevarnostih kofeina in nikotina. V vseh primerih pa sta rituala pitja kave in kajenja ozadje za razkritje čudaških značajev in nepredvidljivih človeških odnosov.Izvirni naslov: COFFEE AND CIGARETTES / Koprodukcijski film, 2004 / Režija in scenarij: Jim Jarmusch / Igrajo: Roberto Benigni, Steven Wright, Steve Buscemi, Iggy Pop, Tom Waits, Cate Blanchett, Jack White, Meg White, Alfred Molina, Steve Coogan, Bill Murray …. | The anthology film brings eleven vignettes, in which different characters sit over coffee and cigarettes and talk about unusual, absurd and philosophical things. An unforgettable sequence in which Steven Wright and Roberto Benigni talk vigorously without understanding each other. Iggy pop and Tom Waits celebrate their cessation of smoking by smoking cigarettes and commenting on musical fame. Cate Blanchett plays in a double role and his envious cousin, and Alfred Molina and Steve Coogan discover that they are related, but Coogan does not mean much. The rapper Gza and Rzo waiter Bill Murray convince the dangers of caffeine and nicotine. In all cases, however, the rituals of drinking coffee and smoking are a background to reveal weird characters and unpredictable human relationships. programme.desc: Doblarec (ali po domače Perilo) je najmočnejši desni pritok Soče v njenem srednjem toku. Hitro poglabljanje Soče v kvartarju mu je zniževalo erozijsko bazo, zato je izdolbel sotesko, v kateri je nekaj slikovitih slapov. Slapovi so tudi na pritokih. Za sotočjem z Lepenko je Doblarec v apnenec vrezal globoko, ozko sotesko. Pod mostom h Kolarju se soteska zoži v korita, globoka 25–30 metrov.V tej skrivnosti vodni krajini potoka Doblarec, soteske in njene širše vodne krajine skupaj z mestom Kanal si je prav zaradi njene skritosti mogoče predstavljati, kako so v starih časih staroverci tu našli prostor za stik z transcedenco. To je bila skupina ljudi, ki so drugače pojmovale svet kot ljudje v njihovi okolici. Živeli in čutili so z naravo in prav v teh temačnih delih soteske, kjer sonce redko posije, so našli mir in prostor za svoje obrede. | Doblarec (or home lingerie) is the strongest right tributary of the Soča River in its middle stream. The rapid deepening of the Soča River in the quartar reduced his erosion base, so he carved a gorge containing some picturesque waterfalls. The waterfalls are also on tributaries. Behind the confluence with the cardboard, the Doblarec cut a deep, narrow gorge into the limestone. Under the bridge to Kolar, the gorge narrows into the troughs, deep 25-30 meters. In this secrets of the water landscape of the Doblarec stream, gorges and its wider water landscape, together with the city of Kanal, it is because of its hiding place to imagine how in the old days the Old Believers found a place to contact with transcendence. It was a group of people who otherwise understood the world than people in their surroundings. They lived and felt with nature, and in these dark parts of the gorge, where the sun rarely shines, they found peace and space for their rituals.

programme.title: Víctor, Victòria | Victor, Victoria
programme.desc: Lany 1934, a París, Victòria Grant, despres del fracàs de la seva actuacio de prova al cabaret Chez Lui, camina afamada pel carrer. Aviat coneix Toddy, un homosexual que li ofereix hospitalitat i que te la brillant idea de convertir-la en Víctor, un transvestit polonès que acabarà triomfant a París. Tot es complica quan King Marchan, propietari de clubs nocturns a Chicago, assisteix a lespectacle i senamora de Víctor.Blake Edwards el director de tota la sèrie de La Pantera Rosa i de pel·lícules tan conegudes com Esmorzar amb diamants, construeix aquí una comèdia musical sobre la identitat sexual que va ser un dels seus últims grans èxits comercials. Amb un guio basat en la pel·lícula alemanya Víktor und Viktoria, de 1933, Edwards va aconseguir la nominacio al millor guio adaptat als Oscars de 1983. Julie Andrews tambe va estar nominada a millor actriu, però finalment nomes Henry Mancini va aconseguir lestatueta, per la seva banda sonora. | In 1934, in Paris, Victoria Grant, after the failure of his test performance at Cabaret Chez Lui, walks on the street. He soon meets Toddy, a homosexual who offers her hospitality and who has the brilliant idea of turning her into Victor, a Polish transvestite who will end up triumphantly in Paris. Everything is complicated when King Marhan, owner of night clubs in Chicago, attends the Lespectacle and Senamora de Victor.Blake Edwards the director of the entire Pink Panther and films series such as breakfast with diamonds, built a musical comedy about the sexual identity that was one of his last major commercial hits here. With a Guio Based on the German film Viktor und Viktoria, 1933, Edwards achieved the nomination of the best Guio adapted to the Oscars of 1983. Julie Andrews was also nominated for best actress, but finally only Henry Mancini won the statueta, by his soundtrack.

Chanel became a dim symbol and freedom, the latter of which will collide in a society dominated by men.

programme.title: Lassassí americà | Thessi American
programme.desc: Mitch Rapp es un joven universitario convertido en un mercenario sediento de venganza tras el asesinato de su novia a manos de una celula terrorista. programme.title: Víctor, Victòria | Victor, Victoria
programme.desc: Lany 1934, a París, Victòria Grant, despres del fracàs de la seva actuacio de prova al cabaret Chez Lui, camina afamada pel carrer. Aviat coneix Toddy, un homosexual que li ofereix hospitalitat i que te la brillant idea de convertir-la en Víctor, un transvestit polonès que acabarà triomfant a París. Tot es complica quan King Marchan, propietari de clubs nocturns a Chicago, assisteix a lespectacle i senamora de Víctor.Blake Edwards el director de tota la sèrie de La Pantera Rosa i de pel·lícules tan conegudes com Esmorzar amb diamants, construeix aquí una comèdia musical sobre la identitat sexual que va ser un dels seus últims grans èxits comercials. Amb un guio basat en la pel·lícula alemanya Víktor und Viktoria, de 1933, Edwards va aconseguir la nominacio al millor guio adaptat als Oscars de 1983. Julie Andrews tambe va estar nominada a millor actriu, però finalment nomes Henry Mancini va aconseguir lestatueta, per la seva banda sonora. | In 1934, in Paris, Victoria Grant, after the failure of his test performance at Cabaret Chez Lui, walks on the street. He soon meets Toddy, a homosexual who offers her hospitality and who has the brilliant idea of turning her into Victor, a Polish transvestite who will end up triumphantly in Paris. Everything is complicated when King Marhan, owner of night clubs in Chicago, attends the Lespectacle and Senamora de Victor.Blake Edwards the director of the entire Pink Panther and films series such as breakfast with diamonds, built a musical comedy about the sexual identity that was one of his last major commercial hits here. With a Guio Based on the German film Viktor und Viktoria, 1933, Edwards achieved the nomination of the best Guio adapted to the Oscars of 1983. Julie Andrews was also nominated for best actress, but finally only Henry Mancini won the statueta, by his soundtrack.

programme.title: Copa Federacion de fútbol playa (M) | Playa Football Federation Cup (M)
programme.desc: Jaen acoge del 19 al 21 de agostos la disputa de la Copa Federacion. Ocho equipos pelean por el título. | Jaen welcomes the Federation Cup dispute from Agostos. Eight teams fight for the title.

programme.title: La Vuelta | The return
programme.desc: El ciclismo completa el calendario 2024 de grandes rondas con la disputa de la Vuelta. La carrera inicia su recorrido el 18 de agosto en Lisboa (Portugal). La meta final, el 8 de septiembre, se cruzará en Madrid. El estadounidense Sepp Kuss fue el vencedor en 2023. | Cycling completes the 2024 calendar of large rounds with the turn dispute. The race begins its journey on August 18 in Lisbon (Portugal). The final goal, on September 8, will cross in Madrid. The American Sepp Kuss was the winner in 2023.

programme.title: Mundial de BMX Racing | Mundial de BMX Racing
programme.desc: El Københavns BMX Klub de Copenhague es el escenario del Mundial de BMX Racing. Las carreras de esta modalidad ciclista exigen una intensa descarga de energía durante un breve período de apenas unos segundos. | The Københavns BMX Klub in Copenhagen is the scene of the BMX Racing World Cup. The careers of this cycling modality demand intense energy discharge for a brief period of just a few seconds.

programme.title: Conexion Vintage | Conexion Vintage
programme.desc: Una mirada al pasado con las mejores retransmisiones emitidas por la cadena en su historia. Baloncesto, boxeo, tenis, fútbol, motociclismo, balonmano, golf... Lo mejor del deporte más reciente. | A look at the past with the best retransmissions issued by the chain in its history. Basketball, boxing, tennis, football, motorcycling, handball, golf ... the best of the most recent sport.

programme.title: Al filo de lo imposible | To the edge of the impossible
programme.desc: Este espacio emite documentales sobre alpinismo, escalada y otros deportes de riesgo al aire libre. El equipo del programa ha logrado hazañas destacables, como filmar en el prohibido reino himalayo de Mustang y en Bhután. | This space issues documentaries on mountaineering, climbing and other outdoor risk sports. The program team has achieved outstanding feats, such as filming in the forbidden Himalayo Kingdom of Mustang and Bhután.

programme.title: Activa2 | Activa2
programme.desc: Programa que anima al espectador a llevar una vida sana basada en el ejercicio físico, el deporte y una alimentacion equilibrada. Las últimas tendencias deportivas, el yoga, mindfullness o el turismo deportivo y consejos muy prácticos para entrenar o para alimentarse. | Program that encourages the viewer to lead a healthy life based on physical exercise, sport and a balanced feeding. The latest sports trends, yoga, mindfullness or sports tourism and very practical advice to train or feed.

programme.title: Cto. España Squash | Cto. Spain
programme.desc: Barcelona alberga la disputa del campeonato de España de squash del 7 al 9 de febrero. Los mejores especialistas pelean por los títulos nacionales tanto en categoría masculina como en femenina. | Barcelona houses the Spanish Squash championship dispute from February 7 to 9. The best specialists fight for national titles both in the male and female category.

programme.desc: «Shazam! Fury of the Gods» spielt einige Jahre nach dem ersten Einsatz. Film zwei folgt Barry Batson , der zusammen mit seinen Pflegegeschwistern Freddy Freeman , Darla Dudley , Pedro Pena , Eugene Choi und Mary Bromfield zu einem Superhelden heranwachst. programme.title: Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood | Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood
programme.desc: Schauplatz ist Los Angeles in den spaten 1960er-Jahren. Rick Dalton , wurde ein Jahrzehnt zuvor als Hauptdarsteller im Fernsehwestern «Bounty Law» zum Star. Karrieremassig gehts aber fur den Sunnyboy seit langerer Zeit abwarts. Er hat es schwer, Hauptrollen zu bekommen. Hauptsachlich spielt er in Nebenrollen Schurken in Serien wie «The F.B.I.» und «Lancer». Rick, der von Selbstzweifeln geplagt wird und sich vor der drohenden Bedeutungslosigkeit furchtet, ist auf der Suche nach dem nachsten grossen Hollywood-Ding, um seine angeschlagene Karriere wieder in Schwung zu bringen. programme.title: Courtois: la vuelta del número 1 | Courtois: The return of number 1
programme.desc: Un retrato que muestra el espectacular trabajo de Thibaut Courtois para llegar al tramo decisivo de la temporada despues de la grave lesion sufrida justo antes del inicio de LaLiga. Experimentaremos la incertidumbre de pasar por el quirofano, el sacrificio que hizo para volver a su mejor nivel, su día a día con Mishel, sus hijos y familia, su intensa agenda y otras facetas hasta ahora desconocidas. La temporada arranca con una grave lesion de Thibaut Courtois. Somos testigos del proceso de recuperacion y de entrega para volver a ser el número 1. | A portrait that shows the spectacular work of Thibaut Courtois to reach the decisive section of the season after the serious injury suffered just before the start of LaLiga. Santiago Bernabeu is not just a stadium. It is a magical place where dreams come true and the impossible happens. The true magic appears in the return of the Champions Semifinals against Bayern in Munich, in which the stadium is conjured to compose another unforgettable deed. It is also Joselu's night that had always sounded to succeed at Real Madrid.

Huracán recibe a Once Caldas en un emocionante partido de octavos de final de la CONMEBOL Sudamericana. Ambos equipos buscarán dar un paso importante hacia la siguiente fase. | Live the matches of the 24th edition of the second most important continental tournament organized by Conmebol, which brings together teams from 10 countries. Hurricane receives Once Caldas in an exciting round of 16 of the South American Conmebol. Both teams will seek to take an important step towards the next phase.
